| slot | exactly 0 for starter; inherited legal 0..63 | P4 Attachment then P7 | Occupied other value is no-overwrite failure; disconnect does not clear persistent equip. |
| client sequence | connection; 1..`Long.MAX_VALUE`, first 1 | P7 client sender/P7 session | Checked increment; after max suppress until disconnect; zero/wrap/reuse invalid. |
| intent/network body | inherited P7 maximum 22 bytes, one intent/packet | P7 codec/dispatcher | No P9 field; oversize/malformed rejects under P7; connection reset owns sequence reset. |
| cast/hit coordinates | structural X/Z `[-30,000,000.0, 30,000,000.0)`, Y `[-20,000,000.0, 20,000,000.0)`, all finite; one origin or hit tuple | pure record constructor, then P7/P5/root live predicate checkpoint | Constructor rejects static-domain failure without world lookup; current dimension, `isInWorldBounds`, `isLoaded`, and world-border failure rejects at the named live checkpoint; no force load; immutable to terminal. |
| direction Q15 | each `-32767..32767`, default none; tuple nonzero | P7 encoding/P5+P6 validation/entity decode | `-32768`, all-zero, nonfinite normalize rejects; ties use `StrictMath.rint`; no saturation beyond the named clamp. |
| profile code | exactly 0 | descriptor, P5 data, P6 records/resolve | Any other int rejects before world mutation. |
| root horizon | root base `current+1`, delay 0, deadline `base+100`; P5 execution tick `<= deadline`, hit claim tick `< deadline` | P5 checked admission/permit and LOWEST Post drain-then-sweep | Both additions checked; child delay 0/scheduled=current and next drain may execute at `<= deadline`; post-drain OPEN sweep closes at `>= deadline`, CLAIMED equality preserves only its inclusive child, and first `> deadline` expires any remainder; no renewal. |
| continuation | one reserved future child/instance/cast | P5 instance/pending owners before P6 | Second/open max+1 rejects; unused close releases; accepted claim consumes once; no completed history. |
| inherited P5 pending | 256/instance, 1024/player, 4096/server; children 32, zero-delay 16; depth 32; lineage events 512 | P5 | Permit reservation counts throughout; existing backpressure/breaker result, checked event/tick sequences, and stop reset. |
| projectile/permit | 1/instance, 16/player, 128/server | P5 one-shot detach plus exact active-permit index before P6 | Max+1 rejects without mutation; entity transfer count-neutral; one bounded post-drain sweep owns deadline/unload/stop closure. |
| authenticated caster live witness | exactly 1/server projectile, 0/client projectile; at most 128/server | no-save entity from server construction through removal | Private final transient identity check only; never P5/P6 retained, serialized, synced, exposed, or resolved by latest UUID replacement. |
| entity size | exactly 0.25 x 0.25 blocks | EntityType registry | Construction mismatch is static/registration failure. |
| initial speed | exactly 1.5 blocks/tick | spawn handoff/entity | Finite decoded direction required; no configurable fallback. |
| inaccuracy/random | exactly 0 / zero draws | entity launch | Any random launch route is forbidden. |
| drag/gravity | air 0.99, water 0.8, gravity 0.03 per active tick | entity | Nonfinite motion closes; claimed inert entity applies no flight step. |
| collision work | at most 1 platform sweep/active entity/tick; at most 128 server sweeps/tick | entity/platform | P9 has no second scan/retry; platform candidate enumeration remains platform-owned. |
| age/lifetime work | age 0..99 sweeps; at most 100 sweeps/projectile | entity plus root deadline | Age 100 closes before sweep; aggregate at caps is checked `128 x 100 = 12,800` lifetime sweeps. |
| accumulated travel | 0.0..64.0 blocks | entity | Final segment clamps to remainder; >64, negative, nonfinite, or addition loss closes. |
| permit identity | nonzero opaque 128-bit + positive server token + entity UUID | P5 token/active index | Zero, same-allocation equality, or current active-index/loaded-entity collision fails without retry; retained at most deadline; restart token invalidates; no historical tombstone. |
| persistent/custom sync state | exactly 0 bytes / 0 bytes | P9 | Any P9 NBT/custom gameplay payload is an authority violation; platform tracking is unchanged. |
| damage magnitude | inherited P6 1..1,000,000 abstract; canonical exactly 4000 -> 4.0F | descriptor/P6 resolve/P9 commit | Must divide by 1000 and convert finite; invalid/max+1 rejects; one `hurt` call at most. |
| mana | canonical node 0/node 1 cost 0/0; inherited balance/operation max 1,000,000,000 | P6 ManaTransactionService | Canonical zero skips transaction; generic positive overflow/insufficient rejects; no cross-tick receipt. |
| cooldown | exactly 0 ticks | P7/P9 policy | No timer/store; recast bounded by P7 and active caps. |
| P6 invocation | exactly 1 request, 1 target where applicable, 1 plan step, <=1 primary mutation per P9 call | P6 | Existing hard ceilings remain higher; extra output/target/step rejects. |
| active cross-tick trace | 0..16 entries/instance, max 128 active instances | P5 diagnostics | Checked aggregate `128 x 16 = 2,048`; slot 16 reserved by exact vocabulary, overflow closes as invariant. |
| terminal trace ring | 0..256 records/server, each <=16 entries | P5 diagnostics | Checked aggregate `256 x 16 = 4,096`; record 257 evicts exactly the oldest; gameplay/ordering unchanged; stop clears. |
| cleanup | at most 128 active-permit observations/closures per ordinary Post or server transition | P5/P9 lifecycle | Exactly one post-drain/index pass; idempotent duplicate close; no unbounded rescan. Error remains no-allocation best effort and may defer bounded lease release to `Stopped`. |

The P7 global work ceiling 64/tick and P8 event/batch budgets retain their own
different scopes and are not copied into P9. P9 also makes no claim that vanilla's
swept-AABB entity candidate count is fixed; only P9's one-sweep invocation is fixed.
All products above are modeled with checked integer arithmetic. Where Java cannot
represent a same-type `max + 1`—for example a long value above
`Long.MAX_VALUE`—the boundary proof uses the exhaust-before-increment transition
rather than constructing an impossible value.

### 63.24 Cross-tick diagnostic vocabulary

Each instance has a fixed 16-slot active diagnostic. A stage occurs at most once;
absent stages consume no slot. The exact ordered vocabulary is:

1. `CAST_ACCEPTED` (including frozen geometry identity);
2. `INSTANCE_PINNED`;
3. `NODE0_MATCHED`;
4. `CONTINUATION_OPENED`;
5. `SPAWN_RESOLVED`;
6. `SPAWN_COMMIT_RESULT`;
7. `PROJECTILE_ACTIVE`;
8. `CAST_PRESENTATION_OFFERED`;
9. `HIT_CLAIM_RESULT` (including immutable hit identity);
10. `NODE1_QUEUED`;
11. `NODE1_MATCHED`;
12. `DAMAGE_RESOLVED`;
13. `DAMAGE_COMMIT_RESULT`;
14. `HIT_PRESENTATION_OFFERED`;
15. `TERMINAL_CAUSE`;
16. `CLEANUP_DISPOSITION`.

Spawn result and CAST offer, and damage result and HIT offer, are separate because
gameplay success must remain distinguishable from presentation submission. The last
two slots are structurally reserved. On every ordinary success, rejection, false
platform result, cancellation, and `RuntimeException` path, terminal recording is
followed by `CLEANUP_DISPOSITION(RELEASED)`. On an `Error`, the no-intentional-
allocation best effort may instead record
`CLEANUP_DISPOSITION(ERROR_DEFERRED)` when the preallocated slot/ring write is
available; it may omit either terminal slot if doing so would allocate, copy a
terminal ring, or risk masking the original object. Such absence denotes an abrupt
fault, never continued gameplay or proof of release. No Error path claims
`RELEASED` while its bounded instance/lease remains retained. A non-Error failure
path skips irrelevant earlier stages and therefore still records its terminal and
cleanup disposition. A path that attempts duplicate
stage insertion or a seventeenth distinct stage is an invariant failure that performs
bounded cleanup; it does not overwrite terminal evidence or continue gameplay.

A terminal record contains fixed scalar identities, stage/result codes, ticks, and
coarse closure reasons only. It contains no `Throwable`, stack trace, entity, player,
level, document, receipt, plan, arbitrary string, collection beyond the fixed stage
array, or presentation payload. An Error cleanup must not copy or materialize a
terminal-ring record if that operation could allocate; the preallocated primitive
best effort is the entire promise. Ring eviction affects diagnostics only and is never
consulted for hit deduplication, scheduling, revision ownership, or gameplay.

### 63.29 P9 product Definition of Done

P9 is complete only when one frozen candidate satisfies all of the following in a
fresh complete P9-Q1 campaign:

1. The four exact typed descriptors and canonical two-node document use formal
   registry/codec/inspection/validation/projection/submission/Store paths, with no
   direct executor or P10 JSON shortcut.
2. A fresh normal authenticated player can invoke `/gramarye starter`, persist one
   exact owner-valid revision in empty slot 0, reconnect/restart without duplication,
   and press the default R key to send the existing P7 intent.
3. P7 derives finite geometry after authorization; P5 pins the exact revision and
   same instance, retains one bounded permit, and queues node 1 only from one
   authoritative accepted server collision without synchronous recursion.
4. Exactly one tracked no-save projectile is inserted on applied spawn, obeys every
   numeric bound and lifecycle rule, and cannot survive or rebind across invalidating
   unload/reload/stop/restart.
5. One accepted legal hit causes at most one queued child and one
   indirect-magic `hurt(4.0F)` attempt. Platform denial yields no applied fact/HIT;
   true yields one, and an unperturbed target loses exactly 4.0 health points.
6. Canonical mana/cooldown are exactly zero; no mana transaction or cross-tick receipt
   exists; rate and active-cap overloads fail closed at max+1.
7. Actual spawn and damage applied facts reach the same P8 service as CAST_RELEASE
   and HIT; frozen geometry, single catalog snapshot, recipients, budgets, and visual
   failure isolation remain exact. Entity tracking, not a P8 duplicate, displays the
   projectile.
8. Static/API/source/JAR evidence proves exact service identities, public inventory,
   no raw/reflection/getter/locator bypass, no client class load on dedicated server,
   and no test or unapproved resource in the production artifact.
9. Pure/direct unit tests, platform GameTests, one actual integrated client, reload,
   stop/restart, dedicated server, and two simultaneous actual clients all prove their
   assigned obligations. FakePlayer, two UUIDs, recorded packets, or one client
   replayed twice cannot satisfy the two-client obligation.
10. All six formal gates below pass on the same exact candidate with complete
    evidence and zero missing/extra/duplicate/rerun/cancelled qualification owner.

P7 ACK remains root-admission truth, not damage, presentation, or client-delivery
truth. A successful local submission remains not a delivery acknowledgement.

## 64. P9-A1.1 S2/S3 Continuation Phase-Allocation Correction

### 64.1 Status, scope, precedence, and exact conflict

This section is a narrow product-design correction to implementation timing and
direct-proof ownership in §63.31. Within that scope it supersedes the S2 and S3
rows, the explanatory S2/S3 sentence immediately after that table, and any
same-meaning earliest-slice statement in §63.27. It also fixes the declaration
staging needed for each production source set to compile independently. It does not
replace the product semantics in §§63.7–63.25, change the final Java/public
inventory in §63.22, add a Gate, remove a direct consumer, or reduce the complete
Definition of Done and G01–G06 in §§63.29–63.30.

The original P9-S2 attempt stopped before source editing or product execution with
`BLOCKED — AUTHORITATIVE PHASE-ALLOCATION CONFLICT`. That historical result remains
accurate. The conflict was exact: the original §63.31 S2 row required direct
`RESERVED`, `OPEN`, claim, close, and queued-child proof while excluding
`EntityType`, the projectile, world mutation, and placeholders. Sections 63.9 and
63.13 permit only one `RESERVED -> OPEN` transition: successful real
`addFreshEntity`, followed by
`RuntimeProjectileContinuationOpenResult.Opened.transferAfterAppliedSpawn(
MinecraftServer, P9StarterProjectile)` after every exact witness passes. The
projectile, insertion, transfer caller, and hit callback are S3 dependencies.
Therefore a non-world S2 execution cannot lawfully manufacture the prerequisite
for `OPEN`, claim, or child publication.

This correction resolves that allocation conflict without implementing P9 runtime
code. It moves every entity-dependent implementation and direct integration proof
to S3. S2 retains server-derived geometry and a real P5-owned firm `RESERVED`
stage. No minimal projectile witness, test-only transition, `Object` or generic
witness, reflection, locator, placeholder entity, unavailable transfer stub,
constructor-created `OPEN`, implicit claim-time activation, or direct
`RESERVED` claim is authorized.

### 64.2 Unchanged final product transition contract

The final product state machine remains exactly §63.9:

```text
RESERVED
  -- successful addFreshEntity and exact ownership transfer --> OPEN
  -- SPAWN_NOT_APPLIED / pre-transfer terminal failure ------> CLOSED_NO_HIT

OPEN
  -- first eligible loaded living hit queues exact child ---> CLAIMED_PENDING_DAMAGE
  -- wrong thread/server ------------------------------------> OPEN, REJECTED, zero mutation
  -- owning validation/queue/expiry/owner failure -----------> CLOSED_NO_HIT

CLAIMED_PENDING_DAMAGE
  -- child terminal/unload/stop -----------------------------> CLOSED_AFTER_HIT

CLOSED_NO_HIT or CLOSED_AFTER_HIT
  -- later claim/close --------------------------------------> unchanged terminal state
```

Only successful real insertion followed by the exact transfer may establish
`OPEN`; only `OPEN` may publish. The final transfer signature, result vocabulary,
same-server/thread requirements, exact loaded planned UUID, dimension,
authenticated-caster object-identity witness, permit-identity witness, and active
index checks remain exactly §63.13. False insertion, an exception, wrong
object/server/thread, stale ownership, or a failed transfer never establishes
`OPEN`. Successful transfer remains count-neutral.

The final claim remains the permit's package-visible
`claimLoadedEntityHit(MinecraftServer, ProjectileHitCandidateV0)`. It performs the
complete §§63.10, 63.16, and 63.17 revalidation and atomically converts the already
held reservation into one same-instance node-1 event. It never creates a second
root, mints a second EventId, invokes node 1 synchronously, or accepts a claim while
the permit is `RESERVED`.

The `Opened` type name denotes the successful result of the one-shot continuation
opener and firm detach. During S2 and before real transfer, that result still owns a
permit whose runtime state is `RESERVED`; the class name is not evidence that the
permit state is `OPEN`. For the same reason, diagnostic stage
`CONTINUATION_OPENED` records successful opener/detach, while
`PROJECTILE_ACTIVE` remains the later S3 post-transfer stage. A shared enum may
declare the word `OPEN` before it is reachable, but declaration is neither
acquisition authority nor direct proof.

All final exact-revision, pin/lease, EventId-hole, pending-count, lineage, deadline,
capacity, cleanup, persistence, restart, failure, retry, close, and diagnostic
rules remain unchanged. An unused held EventId is never rewound or reused; queue
emptiness alone cannot release a live `RESERVED` permit. The S2 no-world-mutation
boundary does not prohibit its authorized P5 memory, reservation, budget, index,
or lease mutations.

### 64.3 Corrected allocation rule and handoff boundary

The phase rule is now exact:

1. S2 implements declarations and legal production paths that require no entity and
   can reach real `RESERVED` ownership on the existing P5 mutable owner.
2. S3 implements declarations and legal production paths whose prerequisite is a
   real projectile, real insertion, transfer, collision, or claim.
3. A final-contract declaration may appear in S2 when required to close S2's sealed
   or typed source shape, but S2 may not construct or use an S3-only value at
   runtime merely because its scalar type is present.
4. A later exact member may be added to its already-existing owner type in S3. S2
   does not carry an always-throwing, unavailable, `Object`-typed, or test-only
   placeholder for that member.
5. Declared contract, implemented surface, runtime-reachable behavior, and directly
   qualified behavior are separate facts and must be reported separately.

The handoff is resource-preserving rather than resource-recreating. S2 allocates
and retains the one firm unit and its identity. S3 changes ownership state only
after real insertion and later converts that same unit to the queued child. No
handoff may duplicate a reservation, advance event high-water again, copy the
permit into a second scheduler, or release and reacquire capacity.

### 64.4 Revised S2 production responsibility and direct acceptance

`P9-S2 SERVER-DERIVED CAST GEOMETRY AND P5 CONTINUATION IMPLEMENTATION`
completes only continuation behavior legally reachable without an entity, together
with all of §63.7's geometry responsibility. Its production obligations are:

1. sample and validate current authenticated `ServerPlayer` geometry only after the
   existing P7 authorization and `AdvisoryTargetCheck.VALID` ordering point;
2. construct exact scalar `CastGeometryExecutionDataV0`, use the four-argument
   package-private P7-to-P5 ingress, and apply the canonical 100-tick root horizon;
3. close the final three-variant `RuntimeExecutionData` vocabulary, append the ninth
   call-scoped `RuntimeExecutionContext` opener, and implement its one-shot
   `(ActionOutputKind.PROJECTILE, 0)` admission;
4. reserve and detach ordinal 1 from the current-dispatch firm child reservation,
   permanently mint and hold exactly `eventIdStart + 1`, construct the deterministic
   permit/projectile UUID pair, and enter `RESERVED` on the real
   `SkillRuntimeService` owner;
5. retain the same instance, exact reference, runtime server token, source-family
   scalars, root deadline, active-index slot, inherited pending capacity, lineage
   work, and exact revision lease while `RESERVED` is live;
6. after a completed-empty ordinary plan, release every undetached call-scoped
   reservation unit normally; after a detached-plus-nonempty invariant failure,
   close the permit and release every undetached current-reservation unit through
   the same bounded cleanup; neither path republishes, rewinds, or reuses the held
   identity;
7. implement every S2-reachable pre-transfer `RESERVED -> CLOSED_NO_HIT` close,
   strict-before-deadline opener rejection, pre-transfer guard/cancellation,
   nonempty-plan invariant, reload owner operation, stop, `RuntimeException`, and
   `Error` containment path within the existing bounded P5 owner, without inventing
   a cross-tick `RESERVED` deadline sweep; and
8. leave a production source set that compiles without `P9StarterProjectile`, a
   test-source substitute for it, or an entity-shaped abstraction.

S2 tests must enter an actual `SkillRuntimeService` dispatch and invoke the opener
through the real call-scoped `RuntimeExecutionContext`. They must not directly
construct a permit, invoke a private helper reflectively, install a second mutable
owner/state machine, or retain an `Opened` aggregate as a product service. An
injected existing `RuntimeExecutionPort` test fixture may exercise the context
inside that dispatch; `P6RuntimeExecutionPortAdapter` remains behaviorally
unchanged during S2 and becomes an opener caller only in S3.

Direct S2 evidence must prove legal entry to `RESERVED`; exact held EventId and
deterministic identities; instance/attribution/server pending counts, active caps,
lineage capacity, and lease retention while the ordinary queue is empty; exact
one-shot, deadline-admission, and capacity rejection; ordinary and
`RuntimeException` cleanup release exactly once; late close remains idempotent; an
exact wrong-thread or wrong-`MinecraftServer` `closeWithoutHit` returns `REJECTED`
with zero mutation and cannot counterfeit a close; an
`Error` propagates as the same object after no-allocation best-effort primitive
queue/index invalidation and may retain the bounded instance/lease graph until
`Stopped`; and no path causes underflow, duplicate publication, EventId rewind,
second scheduler, or synchronous node-1 execution. Geometry evidence retains all
Q15, finite/domain, world-predicate, thread, ordering, and client-hint distrust
requirements from §63.7.

S2 may directly test pure scalar construction and source-family/depth arithmetic.
Those tests prove only the declared scalar/matcher contract. They are not a real
hit, an `OPEN` transition, a claim, or queued-child integration. S2 must report:

```text
OPEN / transfer / claim / queued-child implementation and direct proof
= DEFERRED_TO_S3_BY_P9_A1_1
```

The deferred coordinates are neither S2 PASS evidence nor `N/A`, and S2 completion
does not claim that the same-instance child path is runtime-reachable.

### 64.5 Revised S3 production responsibility and direct acceptance

`P9-S3 PROJECTILE SPAWN, ENTITY, HIT LIFECYCLE AND CLIENT RENDERER IMPLEMENTATION`
receives, in addition to its unchanged §63.31 obligations, the complete
entity-dependent continuation handoff:

1. the real no-save/no-summon `P9StarterProjectile`, registration, server
   construction, tracking, renderer isolation, motion, collision, and lifecycle;
2. the sole real spawn route and boolean `addFreshEntity` truth;
3. the exact `Opened.transferAfterAppliedSpawn(MinecraftServer,
   P9StarterProjectile)` member, its final private owner and transfer-consumed
   state, `RuntimePermitTransferDisposition`, and all loaded-object/caster/permit
   witnesses;
4. the only legal, count-neutral `RESERVED -> OPEN` transition;
5. the permit's exact `claimLoadedEntityHit(MinecraftServer,
   ProjectileHitCandidateV0)` member and `RuntimePermitClaimDisposition`;
6. complete live claim revalidation, source-family integration, conversion of the
   existing held reservation to the exact same-instance node-1 event, and queue
   publication for a later P5 drain; and
7. every `OPEN`/`CLAIMED_PENDING_DAMAGE` duplicate, late, queue-refusal, deadline,
   cancellation, unload, reload, stop, `RuntimeException`, `Error`, and terminal
   cleanup path, including budget/lease ownership across both transitions.

The minimum S3 direct evidence chain is conjunctive:

```text
real S2 P5-owned RESERVED permit
-> real S3 spawn commit
-> addFreshEntity == true
-> exact loaded P9StarterProjectile
-> exact transfer == TRANSFERRED
-> OPEN
-> first eligible authoritative collision
-> exact claim == QUEUED
-> one P5-owned held-ID child in the same instance/reference/lease
-> no inline node-1 invocation
-> eligible and consumed on the next P5 drain
-> assigned terminal cleanup
```

S3 must also prove false or throwing insertion never opens; wrong
thread/server/object causes zero transfer mutation; repeat transfer and claim do not
publish again; and claim before transfer cannot succeed. Ordinary and
`RuntimeException` post-transfer cleanup releases each resource exactly once. An
`Error` instead preserves §63.16: the same object propagates after no-allocation
best-effort primitive queue/index invalidation, with bounded instance/lease
retention permitted until `Stopped` and no double release. Pre-drain owner loss,
reload, stop, or other invalidation must cancel the child through its assigned
negative lifecycle path, but cannot substitute for the normal accepted-claim
next-drain success chain. S3 may queue node 1 while S4's real damage action remains
unavailable. It may not move real damage, mana, or P8 applied-fact behavior forward.

S3 may not cite S2 scalar, pure-model, structural, or `RESERVED` close tests as a
substitute for real spawn, transfer, `OPEN`, claim, and queue evidence. Final P9-Q1
still requires the entire product path on one frozen candidate.

### 65.4 Binding, publication, and null semantics

For a `CastGeometryExecutionDataV0` root, the fifth constructor argument must be the
nonnull `actor` received by the four-argument ingress. The instance must already
contain that exact reference before either publication operation:

```text
slot.instances.put(instance.id, instance)
addCommittedEvent(...)
```

The P9 root is therefore never observable in the instance map, event index, or
queue without its witness. Before publication, P5 repeats the existing current
actor, server, lifecycle, dimension, and exact reference checks, and the
UUID-resolved `ResolvedPlayerOrigin.player()` must be the same object as the ingress
actor. Every rejection before construction retains zero witness. A
`RuntimeException` or `Error` during partial publication follows the existing P5
fault owner; any instance that became reachable must have its witness cleared by
that assigned cleanup rather than by a successful diagnostic.

Every non-P9 instance passes null as the fifth constructor argument. A P9 instance
may have null only when:

1. construction/publication did not succeed and no live instance exists;
2. successful S3 transfer established the entity as exact-witness custodian and
   cleared the P5 slot; or
3. an assigned terminal cleanup cleared the slot.

A live node-0 or `RESERVED` P9 instance with null is an invariant rejection. Null
never means “trust UUID,” “identity not required,” or “bind the resolver's current
player.” The existing generic
`admitRoot(MinecraftServer, RuntimeRootEventSpec)` remains actor-free and must reject
a `CastGeometryExecutionDataV0` P9 root that attempts to bypass the authenticated
four-argument ingress.

### 65.5 Complete current-actor predicate and validation checkpoints

For every P9 operation that still uses the P5 slot, exact identity is necessary but

```text
server.isSameThread()
server.isRunning() && !server.isStopped()
candidate != null
candidate.getUUID() equals the retained PlayerOrigin/player-attribution UUID
server.getPlayerList().getPlayer(candidate.getUUID()) == candidate
instance.hasP9AuthenticatedActorWitness(candidate)
candidate.getServer() == server
candidate.serverLevel().getServer() == server
!candidate.isRemoved()
candidate.isAlive()
candidate.serverLevel().dimension().location() equals the frozen dimension
candidate.connection != null
candidate.connection.isAcceptingMessages()
```

The current runtime token, open lease, event/permit state, deadline, and source
binding remain mandatory enclosing P5 guards; they are not replaced by or hidden
inside this actor predicate.

S2-R2 consolidates that conjunction in exactly one private
`SkillRuntimeService` helper with this descriptor:

The root result must already have passed the InstanceState `== A` predicate, so the

The state transition and clear are non-allocating operations under the same server-

Before `TRANSFERRED`, false insertion, rejection, or a thrown

### 65.8 `OPEN`, claim, queued child, and next-drain custody

After successful transfer, the stable state is:

```text
InstanceState.p9AuthenticatedActorWitness == null
P9StarterProjectile.authenticatedCasterIdentity == A
```

The entity is the sole stable exact-witness custodian through `OPEN`. At claim, the
current UUID lookup yields only a candidate. The loaded exact projectile's
`hasAuthenticatedCasterIdentity(candidate)` must pass together with the existing
permit-object, UUID, token, source-family, reference, deadline, dimension,
liveness, thread, server, and active-index checks. B with A's UUID cannot claim.

A successful claim leaves the same projectile loaded and inert, as already fixed
by §63.17. Its private-final field therefore supplies an uninterrupted witness
through:

```text
OPEN
-> CLAIMED_PENDING_DAMAGE
-> held-ID child queued
-> next P5 drain
-> node-1 guards and damage handoff
-> assigned terminal cleanup
```

The witness is not copied or rebound into InstanceState at claim. At the next
drain, the UUID resolver's actor is again only a candidate; it must match the loaded
exact projectile's witness. The P5 child/permit/index guard and node-1 handoff
repeat the existing exact entity/caster checks. Replacement between claim and next
drain therefore terminals the child without damage or presentation and without
rebinding.

If the entity unloads or is removed before node 1, the existing fail-closed path
removes/expires the child and closes the permit; cleanup needs no valid actor
witness. Terminal entity removal releases the final entity-held strong reference.
P5's slot was already null. No closed permit or child can reopen when a same-UUID
actor or entity later appears.

### 65.9 Locked platform connection and lifecycle coverage

The locked Minecraft 1.21.1 / NeoForm 1.21.1-20240808.144430 / NeoForge 21.1.241
sources establish the supported platform behavior:

| Lifecycle path | Connection identity | `ServerPlayer` identity | Consequence |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| initial TCP or memory-channel login | new | new | New actor cannot equal A. |
| protocol TRANSFER login | new | new | New actor cannot equal A. |
| same-UUID duplicate login | new candidate; old disconnected | new after old removal | Player-list identity and `== A` fail. |
| ordinary logout then reconnect | new | new | Removed A cannot revive. |
| death or End-return respawn | same underlying connection | new | Exact actor detects the clone even though connection identity alone would not. |
| ordinary dimension movement | same | same | Object identity alone is insufficient; frozen-dimension validation remains mandatory. |
| GameTest-only debug reconfiguration | same | new on return | Exact actor rejects the replacement. |
| server stop/replacement | old connections closed | new | Runtime token/server and actor checks fail. |

`ServerConnectionListener` creates a fresh `Connection` for accepted socket and
memory channels. LOGIN and TRANSFER install a fresh login listener. Configuration
completion calls `PlayerList.getPlayerForLogin`, which unconditionally constructs a
new `ServerPlayer`; `PlayerList.placeNewPlayer` then creates and binds a new
`ServerGamePacketListenerImpl`. Duplicate-profile handling disconnects the old
actor. `PlayerList.respawn` constructs a different actor, transfers the old listener
to it, and replaces the UUID-map entry. Ordinary dimension movement instead returns
the same actor. Ordinary logout marks/removes the actor and closes its connection.

The precise supported-platform implication is:

```text
same ServerPlayer reference
=> no supported authenticated Connection replacement occurred

different ServerPlayer reference
!=> the underlying Connection necessarily changed
```

No vanilla/NeoForge-managed supported path was found that rebinds the same
`ServerPlayer` object to a different authenticated connection. The object witness
therefore covers every supported connection replacement conservatively, while
player-list registration, accepting connection, liveness, server, token, and
dimension remain independent conjuncts. The slot is not a general connection epoch
and does not claim to detect arbitrary unsupported mod/JVM mutation of public
fields. This amendment does not authorize a connection witness or epoch framework.

### 65.10 Strong retention, limits, and cleanup order

This is an explicit strong live-object retention exception. The actor reference may
keep its reachable player, connection, level, and world graph alive; it is not
misclassified as scalar state or “only a small reference.”

There is exactly one P5 witness slot per live P9 instance before transfer, and
exactly one entity witness per live P9 permit after transfer. The existing P5 hard
maximum of 128 active instances/server and the P9 shared cap of 128 active
permits/entities/server bound stable authoritative custodians to at most 128 per
server. Transfer is count-neutral. The per-attribution P5 ceiling and the P9
16/player permit ceiling remain stricter in their own stages. Call-scoped aliases
during one synchronous handoff add no persistent custodian, counter, lease, or
revision pin.

The witness is never persisted, serialized, networked, synced, or stored in
`RuntimeExecutionData`, `SkillDocument`, Attachment, journal, SavedData, diagnostics,
or a `Throwable`. It is not copied per tick, captured by a retained callback/task,
placed in a global/parallel map, or retained by P6. It neither authorizes skill,
mana, target, geometry, world, or latest-revision lookup nor extends any deadline or
permit lifetime.

Ordinary close, cancellation, reload, level/server stop, and `RuntimeException`
cleanup must clear the applicable witness and complete each permit, pending,
budget, index, instance, and lease transition exactly once within the existing
at-most-128 active-observation bound. Required authoritative cleanup happens before,
or is non-throwingly isolated from, optional diagnostic materialization. Diagnostic
failure cannot skip cleanup or replace the primary throwable.

On `Error`, the identical object still propagates under §63.16. The existing
no-intentional-allocation best effort includes nulling known InstanceState witness
slots during the bounded pass where possible. Any graph lawfully retained by that
Error policy is completed by `Stopped`; no promise is made for arbitrary VM
corruption or unrecoverable heap failure, and no new catch-and-continue policy is
introduced.

### 65.11 Preserved candidate defects remain blockers

The read-only preserved S2-R1 development candidate independently contains two
known implementation defects:

1. stop/`RuntimeException` cleanup bypasses permit-local terminal transition and
   can perform a worst-case `128 × 128` permit-to-instance search; and
2. terminal diagnostic allocation/failure can interrupt authoritative cleanup.

This amendment does not legalize or repair either behavior. The implementation may
not replace bounded permit transitions with collection clearing, admit unbounded or
quadratic work, make diagnostics a prerequisite for witness/permit/budget/lease
release, suppress the primary throwable, or call the resulting state qualified.
`P9-S2-R2` must correct both defects on a fresh post-amendment base.

Task prompt、舊 phase-local assertion、測試便利性與平台範例不得優先於本節新明定的產品值。也不得以「新章節較晚」為由，修改本節未列入 supersession 的其他契約。

### §66.4 Server root 的完整 construction/registration order

本表定義 server/common composition root 的唯一 construction/registration 順序。每一列的完成先於下一列開始；只有純參數驗證、無產品 side effect 的局部值計算可以留在所屬列中。表中的既有服務必須是後續正常玩家流程實際使用的同一組 instances。

本表所稱「S5 provisioning/composition block」，是 §63 已授權且尚待 S5 實作的同一組 owners，不是允許任意新增 owners 的 placeholder。其內部型別、簽章、依賴與原列名順序承繼 §63；本節把該 block 固定在 R23/R24，禁止將其中的註冊或正常玩家 dispatch 提前到 R22 之前。

| 次序 | 精確建構／註冊責任 |
| --- | --- |
| R00 | 驗證 `modBus`、`exactContainer` 非空，並驗證 container mod id 等於 `Gramarye.MOD_ID`。失敗時不建立後續產品服務。 |
| R01 | 建立原有 `P4E2QualificationFacade`，作為後續 exact Store/player/submission ports 的來源；此操作不是 Store 或 submission service 的建構。 |
| R02 | 呼叫 `P9StarterSkillContent.registerDefinitionTypes()`；同一 mod bootstrap 只宣告一次既有 P9 definition types。 |
| R03 | 呼叫 `MagicRegistries.register(modBus)`，使用 R02 已宣告的同一 registry definitions。 |
| R04 | 呼叫 `P9StarterProjectileRegistration.register(modBus)`。 |
| R05 | 建立並以 `new DescriptorMigrationAudit().register(modBus)` 完成既有 descriptor migration audit 註冊。 |
| R06 | 以 `PlayerSkillAttachmentService.registerOn(modBus)` 建立／取得 root 持有的唯一 `playerSkillAttachmentService`。 |
| R07 | 以 `P8ServerPresentationService.create()` 建立 root 持有的唯一 `p8ServerPresentationService`。 |
| R08 | 從 R07 的同一 instance 呼叫 `profileAvailabilityView()`，取得本 root graph 共用的 `profileAvailability`。 |
| R09 | 以 `P6RuntimeExecutionCapability.forRuntimeAdapter()` 建立既有 `runtimeCapability`。 |
| R10 | 以 `P7ServerAuthorizationBoundary.loginReadyPort(runtimeCapability)` 取得 `p7LoginReadyPort`；參數必須是 R09 的同一 capability。 |
| R11 | 以 `SkillDefinitionStoreService.registerOn(NeoForge.EVENT_BUS, playerSkillAttachmentService, p7LoginReadyPort, exactFacade.storeView(), exactFacade.playerView())` 建立／註冊 root 的 Store；各參數分別來自 R06、R10、R01。 |
| R12 | 以 `SkillDraftCreationService.randomUuidSkillIdSource()` 建立既有 `skillIdSource`。本列不授權預先分配、提交或裝備任何玩家 skill。 |
| R13 | 以 `new SkillDraftCreationService(playerSkillAttachmentService, skillIdSource)` 建立正式 draft-creation service。 |
| R14 | 以 `SkillSubmissionPolicyProvider.defaults()` 建立 root 共用的 `skillSubmissionPolicyProvider`。 |
| R15 | 以 `SkillDefinitionSubmissionService.production(playerSkillAttachmentService, skillDefinitionStoreService.submissionPort(), skillSubmissionPolicyProvider, profileAvailability)` 建立正式 submission service。不得使用空或替代 availability view。 |
| R16 | 以 `SkillSubmissionRecoveryService.create(playerSkillAttachmentService, skillDefinitionStoreService.submissionPort(), skillDefinitionStoreService.onlineReconciliationDependency(), exactFacade.submissionView())` 建立既有 recovery service。 |
| R17 | 呼叫 R16 instance 的 `registerOn(NeoForge.EVENT_BUS)`，維持原 recovery 註冊責任。 |
| R18 | 以 `new P5ServerRuntimeConfig(modBus, exactContainer)` 建立 root 的 P5 設定 owner。 |
| R19 | 以 `SkillRuntimeService.create(NeoForge.EVENT_BUS, skillDefinitionStoreService, skillSubmissionPolicyProvider, profileAvailability, runtimeCapability, p8ServerPresentationService)` 建立唯一 P5 runtime graph，使用 R07–R18 已建立的同一依賴。 |
| R20 | 呼叫同一 P8 service 的 `registerAfterP5(NeoForge.EVENT_BUS)`。本列不得移至 R19 之前。 |
| R21 | 以 `new P7AuthenticatedPlayerCastIngress(skillRuntimeService, playerSkillAttachmentService, skillDefinitionStoreService)` 建立正式 root ingress。 |
| R22 | 呼叫 `P7ServerAuthorizationBoundary.install(runtimeCapability, p7AuthenticatedPlayerCastIngress)`，完成既有 write-once 安裝；不得再次安裝另一個 capability 或 ingress。 |
| R23 | 建構 §63 已授權的 S5 server provisioning/composition block。其正式依賴只能取自本表已建立的 root graph，並保留 §63 對該 block 的原型別、簽章、內部依賴及列名順序。不得建立第二份 Store、Attachment、submission、runtime 或 network owner。 |
| R24 | 註冊 R23 block 在 §63 已定的 provisioning／玩家入口 callbacks。建構本身不得偷跑玩家取得操作；此處只安裝已授權 callbacks，不改其 permission、觸發時機或可重試政策。 |
| R25 | 保留 `NeoForge.EVENT_BUS.addListener(this::handleP5RuntimeStarted)` 的 root lifecycle listener 註冊；callback 內容按 §66.5 保持。 |
| R26 | 保留 `exactContainer.registerExtensionPoint(P4E2QualificationFacade.class, exactFacade)`，使用 R01 同一 facade；完成本次 root construction。 |

R01 是先取得無衝突的既有 facade material，不得藉此解讀為 P3/P4 Store/submission 可以先於 R07–R10 建立。必要依賴明確為：

```text
P8 service → profileAvailability → submission / P5
P6 capability → LoginReadyPort → Store → submission / P5
Attachment → Store / draft creation / submission / ingress
P5 runtime → P8 registerAfterP5
P5 runtime + Attachment + Store → P7 ingress → P7 install
P7 install + 已完成的正式service graph → S5 block建構與註冊
```

本節不授權用 `null`、mutable placeholder、永遠 Ready 的假 port、二段式補值、reflection、第二份服務或額外 public bridge 解開上述依賴。依賴不足時必須拒絕不完整 bootstrap，不能先對外發布半完成 graph。

### §66.5 Construction、registration、runtime callback 與 readiness 的區別

§66.4 的順序不把以下四件事混為同一時間點：服務建構、listener 註冊、事件真正發生、某位玩家 readiness 成立。

`LoginReadyPort` 可以在 Store 建構前取得並注入，但取得 port 不會立即執行 login-ready callback，也不會將任何玩家標為 Ready。Store、recovery 與 P7 原有的 callback 前置條件保持。

`registerAfterP5` 表示既定 registration 責任；本節不以名稱推定所有 runtime callbacks 都須 P5 先於 P8。

既有 `handleP5RuntimeStarted(ServerStartedEvent event)` 的執行順序保持為：

```text
1. p8ServerPresentationService.handleServerStarted(event)
2. limits = p5ServerRuntimeConfig.snapshotForStarted()
3. skillRuntimeService.handleRuntimeStarted(event, limits)
```

本節不修改上述三步的次序、thread、server identity 或 failure 政策；也不改 P5/P8 tick、stopping、stopped 的既有 priority 與有界 cleanup。

S5 provisioning callbacks 只可在其原 server-thread、Store/Attachment/submission/readiness 條件成立時執行。callback 已註冊、client 已收到任何視覺 catalog，或 key mapping 已存在，都不能代替上述 server readiness。

### §66.6 Client construction/registration 邊界

本節不規定 physical client root 與 common root constructors 在平台層級的跨 root 呼叫先後，也不授權 client 呼叫 server bootstrap。兩側各自完成原責任，透過既有 payload／session boundary 交接。

在 physical-client 的正式 composition 中，保留以下既有 P8 區塊順序：

```text
C01. 在 modBus 安裝 GramaryeClient::registerClientRegistry listener。
C02. 建立 P8ClientPresentationExecution.production()。
C03. 以 C02 execution 建立既有 P8ClientPresentationState。
C04. 以同一 state/execution 建立 P8ClientPresentationLifecycle。
C05. 呼叫 P8ClientPayloadDispatchFactory.installClient，使用 C03 state。
C06. 完成 §63.6 已授權的 S5 client sender/input owner 建構與必要注入。
C07. 安裝該 input owner 的 KeyMapping registration、
     ClientTickEvent.Post 消費及必要 gate/session transition callbacks。
```

C06/C07 只補入 S5 的既定責任，不重建 P7 mirror、P8 execution、P8 lifecycle 或另一套 payload registrar。若原 sender/session owner已有正式安裝位置，應在該位置重用，不以本表再次安裝。

KeyMapping 在 physical client 的 mod-bus `RegisterKeyMappingsEvent` 中向平台註冊一次；sender 不得從該 registration callback 直接送出施法。Common／dedicated bootstrap不得解析或建立 client-only KeyMapping/Minecraft 類別。

主消費入口固定為 game event bus 上的 `ClientTickEvent.Post`。screen/focus/pause/session 的其他合法 callback，只用來記錄 suppression、清除 pending 或更新原 lifecycle；不得新增第二條直接送出 CastIntent 的 raw-key、GUI 或 focus callback 路徑。

### §66.7 KeyMapping 與語系 literals

下列值是產品固定 literals，不由 implementation、平台預設或翻譯工具自行選擇：

| 欄位 | 精確值 |
| --- | --- |
| Description translation key | `key.gramarye.cast` |
| Category translation key | `key.categories.gramarye` |
| Default input type | `InputConstants.Type.KEYSYM` |
| Default key | `GLFW.GLFW_KEY_R` |
| Default key modifier | `KeyModifier.NONE` |
| Conflict context | `KeyConflictContext.IN_GAME` |
| Slot supplied by this input | `0` |
| `en_us` description | `Cast Skill` |
| `zh_tw` description | `施放技能` |
| `en_us` category | `Gramarye` |
| `zh_tw` category | `Gramarye` |

R 是預設綁定，不是每tick強制覆寫玩家Controls設定的政策。S5透過已註冊的同一KeyMapping消費輸入，不另以硬編碼R的raw keyboard事件送出技能。原§63.6的slot、離散press、sequence與sender行為保持。

S5的語系resources必須包含：

```json
{
  "key.gramarye.cast": "Cast Skill",
  "key.categories.gramarye": "Gramarye"
}
```

以上是 `en_us` 必要 entries，不表示覆寫該檔案的其他內容。`zh_tw` 必要 entries 為：

```json
{
  "key.gramarye.cast": "施放技能",
  "key.categories.gramarye": "Gramarye"
}
```

本平台的 category 是 translation-key 字串；不得代換成其他Minecraft版本的category註冊模型。`IN_GAME` 只承擔既定 conflict-context 責任，不代替 §66.8 的完整 gate。

### §66.8 Gate predicates、評估順序與拒絕優先順序

以下是正式input gate，而不是只用於測試的建議。所有判定及本mapping pending-state修改都在client thread上完成。若在錯誤thread呼叫，屬於implementation invariant violation：不得送出，也不得跨thread修改KeyMapping；不把它降格為普通suppression以掩蓋錯誤。

Input owner只在自身已完成正常安裝且KeyMapping可用後進入本節。未完成constructor/registration時不得啟動消費loop；此規則不要求創造新的public readiness API。

一次判定依 P01–P08 的順序短路評估。第一個不成立的predicate為本次主要suppression reason；該reason不需要新增network enum或public diagnostic API。先失敗時，不讀取後面可能依賴缺席物件的欄位。

| 順序 | Predicate | 精確意義／本平台對應 | 不成立的主要 reason |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| P01 | `WORLD_PRESENT` | 本次client狀態的 `Minecraft.level != null`。不得改讀server world代替。 | `NO_WORLD` |
| P02 | `PLAYER_PRESENT` | 同次client狀態的 `Minecraft.player != null`。不得保留上一個world/player作fallback。 | `NO_PLAYER` |
| P03 | `PLAY_CONNECTION_PRESENT` | 同次 `Minecraft.getConnection() != null`。必須是本次client play connection，不得以舊connection或任意可用socket代替。 | `NO_PLAY_CONNECTION` |
| P04 | `SENDER_SESSION_AVAILABLE` | §63.6的正式sender已依其正常composition可被呼叫，且其既有session尚未被login/disconnect/world-replacement流程標為失效；本次傳送目的地就是P03的current play connection。此判定從原sender/lifecycle狀態及current connection取得，不新增server-ready、mana、catalog或ownership mirror。 | `SENDER_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE` |
| P05 | `SCREEN_ABSENT` | `Minecraft.screen == null`。任何非null screen都抑制，包括chat、inventory、Controls與不暫停遊戲的screen。 | `SCREEN_OPEN` |
| P06 | `WINDOW_ACTIVE` | 當次client的 `Minecraft.isWindowActive()` 為true。不得用「有connection」或「未paused」替代focus。 | `WINDOW_INACTIVE` |
| P07 | `CLIENT_NOT_PAUSED` | 當次client的 `Minecraft.isPaused()` 為false。不得把所有screen視為同一pause值，也不得以integrated/dedicated名稱直接推定結果。 | `CLIENT_PAUSED` |
| P08 | `NO_PENDING_FLUSH` | §66.9定義的 `pendingFlushRequired` 為false。 | `PENDING_FLUSH_REQUIRED` |

`SENDER_SESSION_AVAILABLE` 不新增sender的capability、sequence或epoch。若原sender每次直接使用current play connection而不保留獨立session binding，P04以它的既有composition可用性及current lifecycle狀態判定，不為本節另造retained connection欄位。

P04不包含「sequence一定可再分配」「mana足夠」「skill已裝備」「server已接受」等額外條件；那些仍交給§63.6及後續正式server邊界，不能在input gate重設計。

ALLOW的完整predicate固定為：

```text
ALLOW = WORLD_PRESENT
     AND PLAYER_PRESENT
     AND PLAY_CONNECTION_PRESENT
     AND SENDER_SESSION_AVAILABLE
     AND SCREEN_ABSENT
     AND WINDOW_ACTIVE
     AND CLIENT_NOT_PAUSED
     AND NO_PENDING_FLUSH
```

P01–P07任何一項失敗，都不能因P08原本為false而送出。P01–P07全為true但P08失敗，屬於恢復後的清除回合，仍不得送出。

### §66.9 Consume/drop 與 recovery flush 狀態機

`pendingFlushRequired` 是client input owner內部的transient suppression狀態，初始值固定為true。它不是network sequence、server epoch、persistent資料、payload欄位或玩家取得marker。

允許implementation在同一client input/lifecycle owner內保存辨識gate邊緣所需的有限booleans或小型enum；不得因此建立另一套session owner、持有舊world/player/connection graph，或新增public同步介面。

本mapping pending clicks的處理順序固定如下：

```text
1. 在client thread取得本次current state。
2. 依P01至P07短路評估環境與sender-session gate。
3. 若任一項失敗：
   a. 將pendingFlushRequired設為true。
   b. 在本次可服務的callback中consume/drop本mapping現有pending clicks。
   c. 不建立CastIntent，不呼叫sender，不分配或推進outgoing sequence。
   d. 結束本次消費回合。
4. 若P01至P07全部成立，但pendingFlushRequired為true：
   a. Consume/drop當時本mapping的全部pending clicks。
   b. 只有清除已完成且current context仍合格時，才設為false。
   c. 該回合不建立CastIntent、不呼叫sender、不分配或推進sequence。
   d. 結束本次消費回合。
5. 若P01至P08全部成立：
   a. 依§63.6原離散press、數量與頻率政策消費有效輸入。
   b. 將該有效press交給原sender。
   c. 每次交給sender前仍須滿足current gate；若期間context改變，
      尚未交付的pending依步驟3/4丟棄。
```

步驟3與4中的consume/drop是對本mapping排隊輸入的實際移除，不是單純return。不得把按鍵保留到screen關閉、focus恢復、解除pause或新session才發送。

清除使用鎖定平台已支持、只影響本mapping的操作。不得直接反射修改KeyMapping private欄位，也不得使用清除所有Minecraft按鍵的global reset作為本mapping的清理實作。

若平台在某段suppressed期間沒有提供可執行清除的callback，應保留 `pendingFlushRequired=true`，於下一個可服務callback先清除。不得因當時未執行callback，將舊pending視為恢復後的有效press。

恢復後第一個清除回合採保守丟棄：無法可靠區分來源的當時pending一律不發送，即使其中可能包含剛恢復時到達的click。清除完成後，後續新的離散press才回到§63.6處理。這是本節明定的產品行為，不留給implementation自行選擇。

正常ALLOW回合的最多送出數量、如何處理hold/repeat、sequence分配時點與sender失敗，保持§63.6。不得把本節步驟5解讀成新的無上限while-send或一律每tick一次政策。

### §66.10 Gate／context transitions 的完整清除責任

以下transition必須使本mapping進入需要flush的狀態：

| Transition | `pendingFlushRequired` 與pending責任 |
| --- | --- |
| Client input owner初次安裝 | 初值true；首次合格回合先flush，不消費啟動前遺留pending作施法。 |
| 進入任何非null screen | 設true；可服務時consume/drop；即使screen在下次正常tick前已關閉，也不得遺失這次suppression。 |
| Window失去active/focus | 設true；不得在focus恢復後重播舊pending。 |
| Client由未paused變paused | 設true；解除pause後依§66.9先flush。 |
| World或player變為不可用 | 設true；不得保留舊物件作送出依據。 |
| Play connection移除、disconnect或原sender session失效 | 設true；不得把pending移交給下一個connection。 |
| 新connection/session建立 | 在允許其第一次施法消費前設true並完成flush；原sequence/session初始化仍由§63.6處理。 |
| Client world unload/replacement或player context replacement | 設true；即使新舊物件的UUID、維度或其他值相同，也不得保留舊pending。 |
| 被抑制context恢復為P01–P07全部成立 | 不直接送出；先執行清除回合。 |
| 清除失敗或清除期間context再失效 | 不設為正常可送出；不建立intent，保留所需flush責任。 |

Implementation必須使用平台已支持的事件／lifecycle hook，在client thread觀察上述已交付的transition。若只在一般消費tick取樣會漏掉「開啟後又關閉screen」等中間suppression，就必須在對應合法callback記錄dirty/flush狀態；不得以「下個tick看來已合格」忽略已觀察的轉換。

這些callback只負責gate/lifecycle或pending清除，不直接呼叫sender。沒有授權第二條raw keyboard、screen keyPressed或focus callback施法路徑。

本節不要求猜測作業系統或平台根本未交付的physical event。有效新press仍按§63.6定義；禁止的是把已抑制、已清除或屬於舊context的pending重新建回。

### §66.11 Gate動作真值表

下表採§66.8的first-failing-predicate順序。`—`表示該欄不影響此列結果且不要求為產生diagnostic繼續求值，不表示該條件已被證明成立。

| World | Player | Connection | Sender session | Screen absent | Active | Not paused | No flush | 動作 | Sender calls | 新sequence分配 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| false | — | — | — | — | — | — | — | SUPPRESS_AND_DROP；flush=true | 0 | 0 |
| true | false | — | — | — | — | — | — | SUPPRESS_AND_DROP；flush=true | 0 | 0 |
| true | true | false | — | — | — | — | — | SUPPRESS_AND_DROP；flush=true | 0 | 0 |
| true | true | true | false | — | — | — | — | SUPPRESS_AND_DROP；flush=true | 0 | 0 |
| true | true | true | true | false | — | — | — | SUPPRESS_AND_DROP；flush=true | 0 | 0 |
| true | true | true | true | true | false | — | — | SUPPRESS_AND_DROP；flush=true | 0 | 0 |
| true | true | true | true | true | true | false | — | SUPPRESS_AND_DROP；flush=true | 0 | 0 |
| true | true | true | true | true | true | true | false | FLUSH_ONLY；成功後flush=false | 0 | 0 |
| true | true | true | true | true | true | true | true | ALLOW；交給§63.6原press/sender政策 | 依§63.6 | 依§63.6 |

以上九列完整覆蓋八個gate predicates的所有布林組合；第一個false決定suppression，不允許不同程式分支採用不同的條件優先順序。

`SUPPRESS_AND_DROP`、`FLUSH_ONLY`與reason literals是本節的規範標記，不要求將它們新增為產品public enum、payload欄位或persistent schema。

### §66.12 Sequence、sender與server authority保持

只有§66.11最後一列可以將新的有效press交給§63.6 sender。其餘列不得預先建立intent、推進sequence、消耗sequence quota、保存待重送request或等待ACK後補送。

有效press已交給sender之後，sequence分配、exhaustion、傳送成功／拒絕／exception及其他原結果完全按§63.6處理。本節不新增rollback、重新編號、自動重試、ACK-timeout補送或回復舊press。

沒有pending click的正常回合也不得僅因gate為true而產生CastIntent。恢復gate不代表玩家已做一次新的離散press。

Client gate只是input admissibility，不是server authorization。P7仍必須從authenticated actor、正式equipped reference、owner及definition決定接受；geometry由server取樣；P5/P6負責正式runtime、transaction、spawn、damage與applied facts。Integrated client不得直接呼叫server service繞過同一路徑。

本節不改R與slot `0`所指向的canonical玩法、不新增payload欄位，也不將P7 client dispatch generation、server epoch與outgoing sequence合併為同一數值。

### §66.13 S5-R1的direct acceptance義務

舊 §67 已提出單一pre-open候選，但在 A14-G03 preflight 暴露兩個規範問題：`maintainTransportLiveness()` boolean沒有真值語意；同一 Connection 的 PLAY→CONFIGURATION→PLAY 沒有epoch witness，無法把duplicate LoggingIn與新PLAY區分。原118/118模型只證明其所選解釋，不解決原稿歧義。本節明確取代該未生效材料；原preflight仍是BLOCKED，formal attempts仍為0。

### §67.4 身份與epoch定義

`C`表示 `net.minecraft.network.Connection` 的exact物件身份；`L`表示該次PLAY的 `net.neoforged.neoforge.common.extensions.ICommonPacketListener` exact物件身份。只用reference `==`，不用equals、hash、UUID、address、字串、catalog generation或listener class名稱辨識epoch。

**Epoch key E = (C,L)**。`same C + same L`才是相同epoch；`same C + new L`是平台已換入的新PLAY。不得在每次payload或LoggingIn自行製造listener替身，亦不得為same-C每次通知無條件重開。

一個incoming E具有當前合法PLAY身份，須按此順序核對：C/L非空；`L.getConnection() == C`；L為PLAY且接收方向符合clientbound；C仍live；C透過locked平台公開getter取得的current packet listener與L為同一reference。具體方法使用 `Connection.getPacketListener()`、`ICommonPacketListener.getConnection()` 與 `protocol()` 及既有packet flow來源，須由§67.25驗證exact平台可用性及可見性。

這是單次當前身份觀察，不是凍結平台永不再切換。State在其monitor內決定admission前重新取樣；main的drain/bind/publish及event應用前也須重驗selected E仍current。不得在鎖外久存一個boolean、進鎖後當成永遠有效。檢查後才發生的合法protocol切換，會使該epoch已接受的工作失效；它不能把舊工作重新歸給新epoch。

CONFIGURATION只需辨識current listener不是selected PLAY，以及其protocol；configuration listener本身不得另行長期保存。不能只靠某個tick曾看見CONFIGURATION作唯一epoch見證：即使整段切換發生在兩個maintenance callbacks之間，新L也必須被辨識。

### §67.5 Custody與bounded狀態

唯一 `P8ClientPresentationState` 准許新增以下private欄位，使用精確平台型別：

```java
private Connection p8TransportConnection;
private ICommonPacketListener p8PlayListenerWitness;
```

兩者至多各一個。`p8PlayListenerWitness`為selected epoch的L，不是listener list、retired-listener集合或configuration listener備份。State可保存有限phase、typed ticket、counter、published generation、至多一個deferred cleanup obligation及唯一 `private long pendingLifecycleInvalidationGeneration`（初值0）；不得形成以每個packet/epoch累積的Map/List。

一個listener可能間接保留player/world/platform graph，這是本次明示且受lifetime約束的例外，不宣稱只付一個指標大小。PLAY失效且平台listener已變更時，舊L從retained欄位釋放；若同pair尚live且已terminal，RETIRING可以保留它作拒絕fence，直到connection關閉或平台換入不同listener。Physical C也只保留到本節指定的close/replacement；不得建立永不移除的歷史registry。

Tasks、mailbox票據、cleanup票據、開啟結果、maintenance結果仍不得保存C/L、context、player、world或callback。它們只帶typed無live-reference的epoch/attempt identity、generation及原bounded資料。方法同步call stack短暫使用C/L允許，不能逃逸到Future、timer或lambda佇列。

唯一client lifecycle可新增一個 `long pendingWorldLoadGeneration`，用來標記原 `pendingWorldLoad` 的歸屬；0表示沒有pending。可另用既有有限局部狀態，但不保存另一份listener/Connection。其他P7/P5/P6、render backend、profile/fact不取得本例外。

### §67.6 Exact internal operations與結果型別

後續S5-R2使用下列package-private形狀；新record/enum均位於 `com.yo1no.gramarye`，不加public modifier。原payload-only、Connection-only open及boolean maintenance/logout production overload不保留：

```java
// P8ClientPayloadDispatchPort及原forwarder/implementations：
Optional<P8ClientDispatchTask> prepareProfileCatalog(
        Connection sourceConnection,
        ICommonPacketListener sourcePlayListener,
        ProfileCatalogPayload payload);
Optional<P8ClientDispatchTask> preparePresentationEvent(
        Connection sourceConnection,
        ICommonPacketListener sourcePlayListener,
        PresentationEventPayload payload);

// P8ClientPresentationState；以下由client-main呼叫：
P8ClientConnectionOpenResult onConnectionOpened(
        Connection exactConnection, ICommonPacketListener exactPlayListener);
P8ClientTransportMaintenanceResult onLoggedOut(
        @Nullable Connection expectedConnection,
        @Nullable ICommonPacketListener expectedPlayListener);
P8ClientTransportMaintenanceResult maintainTransportLiveness();
boolean isCurrentPublishedPlayGeneration(long expectedGeneration);

// Package-private，components不得保存live graph：
record P8ClientConnectionOpenResult(
        boolean opened,
        long publishedGeneration,
        Optional<P8ClientDispatchTask> catalogDrain,
    P8ClientTransportMaintenanceResult maintenance) {}

enum P8ClientCleanupDisposition {
    NONE, CLEARED, SUPERSEDED
}

record P8ClientTransportMaintenanceResult(
        P8ClientCleanupDisposition cleanupDisposition,
        OptionalLong invalidatedPublishedGeneration) {}
```

Records的實作須驗證non-null components。`opened=true`要求publishedGeneration>0；false要求generation=0且drain empty。True只表示本次新PLAY generation已發布，不等於catalog installed。Duplicate/no-op是false，不回傳既有generation當成新publication。Open result內的maintenance承載本次前代清理／失效通知，lifecycle無論opened真或假都先按§67.16消費它；真正duplicate且無其他責任時必為NONE＋empty。

Maintenance optional有值時須為>0的**實際曾發布且已失效generation**。它不是目前counter、selected pre-open ticket、是否有任意cleanup的boolean，亦不是新epoch身份。沒有published predecessor就用empty，不用0/synthetic generation塞入OptionalLong。

`isCurrentPublishedPlayGeneration(g)`為read-only、main-thread、synchronized觀察：g>0，state為OPEN/connected、g等於目前published generation，而且selected E仍live/current PLAY時才true；其他情況false。此查詢不重開、加counter、選新connection或執行cleanup。

Factory仍write-once；未安裝client state的原Unavailable行為保持。Forwarder傳遞C/L但不retained它們。Record/enum雖有供同package使用的accessors，新增public bridge/API為0。

### §67.7 身份來源與lifecycle adapter

NETWORK的C/L只能來自該次payload的 `context.connection()` 與 `context.listener()`。不保存context，也不在NETWORK改抓Minecraft的current player/world來猜來源。先核對L與C相配及current PLAY，再進入state admission。

LoggingIn在main從事件C及事件player所屬的PLAY listener取得E，並核對與當時 `Minecraft.getConnection()`、current player及C的current listener一致。不得對晚到事件直接補上「現在的listener」。Exact21.1.241中event player的connection取得方式、其不可變/換代語意與firePlayerLogin時點須在§67.25核對。

LoggingOut使用事件自身C及其event player可提供的L；缺任一資料即依§67.18的partial-witness規則處理。不得用current listener/player補齊舊事件，因為那可能把L1 logout改寫成L2 logout。

同C不同L的舊packet與舊event不得以server address、玩家UUID或新connectionGeneration重新認領。Common state只依common接口判定；client-only adapter的Minecraft/LocalPlayer使用不得洩漏到common class loading。

### §67.8 States與同步邊界

| Phase | connected | Retained C/L | Catalog責任 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| EMPTY | false | null/null | 無pending catalog |
| CONFIGURING | false | live C/null | 非PLAY間期，無pre-open/mailbox；可有舊published cleanup obligation |
| PREOPEN | false | exact C/L | 至多一個同E候選，未發布generation |
| OPENING | false | exact C/L | 同E候選可更新；有一個main open-attempt票據 |
| OPEN | true | exact C/L | 正常mailbox/in-flight；pre-open欄位empty |
| RETIRING | false | exact C/至多同L | 無pending payload；僅作terminal same-pair拒絕fence |

`CONFIGURING`是本地尚未open的phase，不要求保存configuration listener，也不對外提供新protocol enum。Live C在current listener暂為null/非PLAY時也不靠client world存在性強行重開。

Admission、selected E、ticket、published-generation身份與charge都在原state monitor下決定。NETWORK不呼叫factory、render/audio backend或execution.clearAll。外部execution cleanup/preparation不移入大鎖；回鎖後重驗票據與current E。

Main backend cleanup期間不允許發布任何新epoch；NETWORK仍可把合法新E選為PREOPEN並保留候選。Main callbacks正常由主執行緒序列服務。若外部callback重入並要求在尚未返回的clearAll中發布新epoch，必須按既有invariant failure/exception政策明確拒絕publication，不以假opened結果或新的deferred-open queue隱藏重入。Source/model要證明正常登入/configuration鏈不需要這種重入publication。此限制不阻止正常排隊至外層cleanup返回之後的LoggingIn。

### §67.9 Published epoch與cleanup obligation不等於selected candidate

State必須分清selected E與目前/最近需要收束的published execution generation。A已失效、B僅PREOPEN時，state可selected B，仍有A的一個無live-reference cleanup ticket；這不表示B已擁有A的backend或lifecycle flag。

只有曾發布的epoch能產生需要按generation回報的lifecycle失效。移除未open的候選僅釋放其payload/charge/ref，不能捏造published generation。尚未published的OPENING只消耗其已分配counter值，不因名稱OPENING就視為已發布。

新generation發布之前，所有前代backend cleanup obligation必須已成功完成或有可核對的先前完成事實。一次只有一個published backend owner，因此未收束published obligation至多一個。連續多個PREOPEN候選被替換不產生更多published cleanup票據。

原ticket已在新epoch發布前被收束，晚到的舊cleanup callback只能回報SUPERSEDED/無效，不得再執行無差別clearAll。不能用「先清backend，再比較generation決定是否清flag」；backend本身也必須先受ownership保護。

### §67.10 NETWORK catalog admission

每次prepare按以下決策順序完成有界操作：

1. Non-null C/L/payload、原codec/schema/body/domain驗收保持；格式合法不等於其epoch仍current。
2. 在state monitor內取得§67.4的current-PLAY關係。Incoming C已closed、L不屬C、L不是PLAY或已不是C的current listener：stale/unavailable來源不保留、不改新selected candidate、不分配正常sequence。既有非法payload政策保持，不把失效來源當成合法最新catalog。
3. 觀察已有selected E。如果C已關閉或其current listener已變更，先logical retire該舊PLAY、失效其tokens與正常queued責任；舊published backend責任只記為main cleanup。這不執行backend，也不拿舊generation比較incoming。
4. EMPTY可由live且current PLAY的incoming E選為PREOPEN，保留候選。CONFIGURING的同一C若收到current新PLAY L，也選為PREOPEN。不同而已失效的舊C不阻擋新C。
5. Same selected E處於PREOPEN/OPENING：沿§67.11保留最新合法catalog，返回empty task表示已保留/coalesced而非installed。
6. Same E處於OPEN：沿原mailbox/bind路徑處理；task捕獲無live-reference epoch token與published generation，不捕獲C/L。
7. 同E仍RETIRING而platform尚未換listener：不重開、不保留payload；只有不同current PLAY witness或真正新transport才能形成下一epoch，重複同E LoggingIn不能當作retry。
8. Same physical C但incoming為新的current L2：即使state仍標OPEN L1，亦須先retire L1，再以L2建立PREOPEN；不走different-transport ambiguity rejection。L1 stale callback不能反向選回L1。
9. 不同live C、舊selected transport仍live且未由current-main裁定replacement：保留原候選；沿既有Unavailable/disconnect incoming-context途徑顯式拒絕。不得last-arrival-wins或跨C/L比較catalog generation。

第9項不是正常reconnect預期路徑；locked source與後續產品測試須證明一般首次登入、取消後重連、sequential replacement/transfer不被誤拒。Main current LoggingIn(B)仍可在確認平台current context後替換A。任何stale callback只失效自己的工作，不得因此disconnect目前B。

若C的listener在本次合法admission之後才切換，當前票據仍只屬舊E；稍後maintenance或main consumer使其失效，絕不把它重標成新L。這是epoch終止，不是對仍有效epoch靜默丟棄最新catalog。

### §67.11 Catalog coalescing與budget

本節不提高既有limits；數值真實來源仍為PresentationLimits。

| Constant | Base value |
| --- | --- |
| MAX_CLIENT_CATALOG_RETAINED_BODY_BYTES | 468683L |
| PROFILE_CATALOG_PACKET_OVERHEAD_BYTES | 26 |
| MAX_CLIENT_COMBINED_QUEUED_BYTES | 573440L |
| MAX_CLIENT_PENDING_EVENTS | 64L |
| MAX_CLIENT_PENDING_EVENT_BODY_BYTES | 65536L |

結構上限固定：pre-open candidate≤1；pre-open candidate數＋normal pending catalog mailbox數≤1。既有in-flight catalog依原獨立retained accounting處理，不能因換epoch把仍在call stack中的資料記成已釋放。

候選charge為checked-long的bodySize+26，計入原combined queued budget。同E較新catalog替換使用 `combined - oldCharge + newCharge`；相同/較舊值no-op。同C的新L2是一個新的比較domain：L1 installed generation即使大於或等於L2 payload，也不能阻擋L2的首次catalog。

PREOPEN→normal mailbox轉移同一份payload/charge ownership，不複製一份、不雙算、不先加後減造成假性容量拒絕。Old cancel/release只能處理自己的ticket。Inactive old execution、pending queue與本次decode短暫輸入的責任分開。

既有最大pending catalog加event queued算例維持：`468683 + 26 + 65536 + 64×29 = 536101 ≤ 573440`。這不是heap峰值或in-flight allowance。不得降低最大body、增加capacity或丟掉current最新catalog掩蓋accounting問題。

### §67.12 Generation與duplicate規則

P8的既有 `connectionCounter` / `connectionGeneration` 繼續使用nonnegative long與Long.MAX_VALUE exhaustion，不新增wire counter。New PLAY epoch用同一counter分配，不以Connection物件相同而重用已發布generation。

固定計數規則如下：

| 動作 | Counter／publication |
| --- | --- |
| 只選定PREOPEN或CONFIGURING | 不分配正式generation |
| 同(C,L)已OPEN的真正duplicate LoggingIn | 完全no-op，counter/installed/world狀態不變 |
| Main開始一個非duplicate open attempt | 在既有exhaustion檢查後counter恰加1，分配attempt generation；只在§67.13全部完成後發布 |
| 先前published g被NETWORK logical retire | 不在NETWORK增加counter；先使token/phase無效，保存待main處理的g |
| Main服務published g的首次失效 | 若counter仍等於g且未達MAX，恰加1作失效marker；若已大於g或已處理則不再加；不wrap |
| 未published候選取消 | 不捏造published invalidation；已分配但未發布的open attempt值仍消耗，不回滾 |
| 重複cleanup／stale result／stale release | 不再改counter |

因此從g=1終結後可先有marker2，再發布新epoch3；不要求re-entry必是1→2。Invalidation result保存的是舊published **1**，不是目前counter2或新generation3。若counter已MAX，禁止任何新publication；清理仍完成，不靠wrap/reuse逃過exhaustion。

新L2與同L1 duplicate的判定使用current (C,L)與phase；不是靠目前catalog值或LoggingIn出現次數。L1一旦terminal，不可因相同C/L再次LoggingIn而恢復舊generation或重播payload。

### §67.13 Main open、cleanup期間到包與採納

`onConnectionOpened(C,L)`先由adapter完成event/current-context核對，再由state重驗§67.4。次序固定：

1. 錯thread是invariant failure。Stale/noncurrent E不publication。已OPEN的同E duplicate回false/0/empty，不清lifecycle flag。
2. 在monitor內retire舊published epoch；matching E的pre-open候選保留，不被舊clearConnectionScopedState無條件刪除；其他E候選釋放。
3. Main處理尚待完成的舊generation失效計數；為本次new attempt分配generation與票據，標OPENING/connected=false。必要cleanup obligation歸屬明確。
4. 鎖外完成前代 `execution.clearAll()`；此期間同E NETWORK可以更新唯一候選，其他合法replacement只改admission，不執行backend或publication。Main cleanup busy期間禁止nested publication，依§67.8處理異常重入。
5. 回monitor確認cleanup成功且已收束、attempt仍有ownership、selected C/L及其current PLAY身份仍相同、transport live、generation未被取消。任何一項失敗不得發布。
6. 同一線性化步驟發布OPEN/connected與published generation，將當時matching最新候選移交原mailbox；建立至多一個正常CatalogDrainTask。沒有候選則opened=true且task empty，等待正常同E payload。
7. 返回typed open result。Lifecycle只在result g仍是state當前published generation且event仍current時，進行該epoch的world-init，之後在main、state鎖外執行drain。

第4步期間及第5/6步附近到達的同E catalog，只能落入pre-open或正常mailbox其中一條有效責任，不得留下lost-wakeup窗口。Task使用mailbox當下最新值，不攜帶舊payload副本忽略替換。

如果result返回後在world-init/drain前發生context切換，釋放該task原有reservation；不以當前E改寫其捕獲身份。True不代表installed，false也不能啟動world-init當成成功。

### §67.14 Same-Connection PLAY re-entry完整規則

支援既有 `PLAY L1 → CONFIGURATION → PLAY L2`，C可以相同，且不要求有LoggingOut。L2必須是平台正式建立並安裝的不同listener identity。

| 觀察／事件 | 固定結果 |
| --- | --- |
| OPEN(C,L1)，同E重複LoggingIn | Duplicate no-op |
| Selected L1已不是C的current listener，current是CONFIGURATION | Retire L1、清理其接受範圍；釋放舊L witness，C live時可留CONFIGURING；不假裝physical disconnected |
| 同C已換成current PLAY L2，catalog先於LoggingIn | 辨識新E、PREOPEN保留L2候選，L1的installed/catalog sequence不套到L2 |
| Matching LoggingIn(C,L2) | 舊cleanup完成後發布新generation，採納L2候選 |
| Configuration全部發生在兩個maintenance ticks間 | 第一次L2 payload／LoggingIn／maintenance以listener identity辨識換代；不要求必曾poll到CONFIGURATION |
| L1舊task/payload在L2後到達 | L1不是current或ticket不符，不能重新認領或清L2 |
| 同C/L的dimension change或respawn | 不因world/player變更自行分配PLAY epoch；維持原world/player lifecycle |
| Physical C關閉 | 終結其selected/deferred責任並釋放C/L，沒有以新L恢復closed C |

Maintenance可以觀察selected C目前已安裝L2並選定空PREOPEN，但不能由此發布PLAY或合成catalog。它仍等待真正current LoggingIn。Config期間不保留舊L1供後續比較；已退場的ticket/token維持stale拒絕，L2來時由platform-current身份重新選定。

新epoch只有原server流程實際送來的catalog可進入；不複製L1 installed snapshot作L2新catalog，不新增ACK/retry。如果locked-source顯示既有re-entry所需catalog publication在正常server流程缺席，§67.25必須如實列出；不能加手動reload把此Gap藏住。

### §67.15 Maintenance typed result的完整真值語意

`P8ClientTransportMaintenanceResult`的兩個components彼此獨立：cleanup disposition回報本次對backend cleanup責任做了什麼；OptionalLong精確指出要通知lifecycle的哪個已發布generation已失效。不得把enum非NONE轉成「清目前pendingWorldLoad」。

| Disposition | 精確意義 |
| --- | --- |
| NONE | 本次沒有執行backend clear，也沒有處理已被其他合法clear完成的stale ticket；可只完成logical invalidation/ref釋放。 |
| CLEARED | 本次對仍屬於有效cleanup obligation的前代backend成功執行clear，並已收束票據。不表示被清的是當前selected candidate。 |
| SUPERSEDED | 本次面對的舊票據已可證明在後代publication之前由其他合法main cleanup完成；本次沒有再呼叫clearAll。沒有該先前完成事實不能使用此值。 |

OptionalLong只有確實曾published的g已失效且需要通知時present。它可以指已不再selected的A。沒有generation需要通知時empty；不以目前selected B填值。重複消費同一g須idempotent，不產生新generation。

| 當前情境 | 合法結果／lifecycle動作 |
| --- | --- |
| 沒有cleanup或失效 | NONE + empty；不清flag |
| A deferred cleanup，B只是PREOPEN，A有published gA | CLEARED + gA（無需clear的純logical情況可NONE + gA）；只清屬gA的flag，B候選/charge不變 |
| A stale ticket，B已合法OPEN於gB | 新的maintenance只可SUPERSEDED + empty，因gA必已在B發布前移交；禁止clearAll，屬gB的flag不變。已在較早call返回的gA result則按下一列matching規則消費。 |
| 當前OPEN A終結 | 依本次cleanup事實回CLEARED/NONE + gA；清屬gA的flag |
| 只有未published PREOPEN終結 | NONE + empty；釋放candidate/ref，不能捏造g清別的flag |
| 舊result gA晚到，而flag已屬gB | result資料不變；consumer比較不符，不清gB |
| Cleanup失敗 | 不產生成功的CLEARED；先完成可完成的logical/accounting收束，依原政策丟出primary failure；exception consumer依§67.16處理 |

OptionalLong的取值由唯一 `pendingLifecycleInvalidationGeneration` 決定，不由implementation任選「是否需要通知」：

1. Published g首次logical失效時，該欄為0則設g；已為同g不重複加入。尚有不同g時不得覆寫：新epoch publication本來就必須先完成前代通知移交，此狀態是invariant failure。
2. 正常返回maintenance/logout result時，將該欄的非零g移交為OptionalLong，並在同一monitor步驟清為0；欄為0則必為empty。這是通知責任移交，不代表consumer已執行。
3. Open在新publication之前，先完成前代cleanup；將pending g納入其open result內的maintenance。Result合法建構、通知slot清空及new publication必須形成一個受monitor保護的commit；結果配置失敗不得先發布新epoch。若false返回，也以相同規則移交已發生的失效通知。
4. 已移交通知的舊result若較晚被lifecycle消費，它仍保存原g；consumer只做matching clear。已清slot不再由下一次maintenance重複報g。Stale ticket沒有權利把自己的舊g重新塞進通知slot。
5. Cleanup throw而無正常result時，通知slot不冒充已交付；lifecycle先用§67.16的stale guard處理自己的flag並傳播primary。下一次合法maintenance可再次移交仍待通知g；重複清同g是idempotent。

本機結果傳遞不新增wire ACK、公開session通知或異步result queue。State至多一個pending通知g，不建List。開啟B後仍可能存在已返回的A結果，但不得存在可再清B的未收束A backend責任。

### §67.16 pendingWorldLoad的generation歸屬與consumer

既有boolean保留，但綁定如下不變量：false時 `pendingWorldLoadGeneration == 0`；true時generation>0，且是在真正published/world transition中取得的g。不得用selected pre-open ticket、player UUID、Connection hash或當前counter marker替代。

Lifecycle設定pendingWorldLoad=true前，取得當次published g並核對 `isCurrentPublishedPlayGeneration(g)`。任何已有world-load/unload消費flag的分支，先確認該flag的generation仍current；不是當前generation就只清舊flag，不把它帶到新epoch的world-unload邏輯。

消費maintenance/logout result時，唯一依result主動清除flag的規則是：optional存在g，且pendingWorldLoad=true且pendingWorldLoadGeneration==g。此時同時清boolean與generation。`cleanupDisposition`本身不參與是否清除的判定。

每個相關lifecycle入口在進入／退出（包含exception finally）時另作有界stale-flag guard：若flag有g但 `isCurrentPublishedPlayGeneration(g)`為false，只清該stale flag；如果它已屬新B且仍current，必須保留。禁止無條件finally清flag。

真正opened=true的新epoch在world-init前，清除不屬該published generation的旧flag；duplicate opened=false不得重跑world-init或清當前flag。Result返回後如E已切換，不能因本次曾opened=true就對新context呼叫舊world-init。

若cleanup throw，沒有正常typed結果也必須透過上述query guard收束已失效flag，然後保留原primary throwable。不得把exception吞成NONE/CLEARED。Query自身錯thread或其他invariant failure不能取代已保存的primary failure，secondary診斷按原規則處理。

### §67.17 Maintenance演算法與執行時機

既有P8 lifecycle在client-main的 `ClientTickEvent.Pre` 呼叫maintenance；不受P8 rendering Post的paused、world-present或tick-rate gate抑制。登入、登出及其他既有合法lifecycle可同步觸發同一有界maintenance，不能有第二個mutable owner。

在monitor內觀察至多一個selected C及它的current listener：closed C要retire並釋放；same C current listener變更要retire舊PLAY，必要時轉CONFIGURING或選current新PLAY為PREOPEN；沒有變更且live的PREOPEN不能因無world/player而丟掉。將必要logical invalidation與無live cleanup票據固定，再於main鎖外執行受ownership保護的backend clear。

完成clear後回monitor重驗ticket。若NETWORK已選B PREOPEN，收束A obligation但不刪B候選；若更晚epoch已由另一合法cleanup/publication完成，舊ticket只能SUPERSEDED，不能再清backend。Cleanup失敗不標為已完成，不發布依賴它的新epoch；不自動loop retry。後續合法lifecycle若按原failure政策可嘗試新的cleanup，仍須明確ownership，不能把failed ticket當成功。

Transport/listener觀察是O(1)，不是扫描所有connection。Event/reservation/execution清理仍走各自既有固定上限，不能誇稱全部backend cleanup必然O(1)，也不能增加無界工作。

Pre-open沒有LoggingIn/LoggingOut而C關閉，在下一個平台實際交付且可服務的maintenance callback釋放。Main不運作時不承諾wall-clock時限。不新增timer、thread、Future listener、channel attributes、Netty pipeline hook或全process掃描。

### §67.18 Logout與partial witness

`onLoggedOut(expectedC, expectedL)`使用事件自身身份：

| Event witness | State行為 |
| --- | --- |
| C/L完整、pair一致、matches selected E | 終結該E、回typed invalidation/cleanup結果；同pair仍live/current時RETIRING拒絕重开 |
| C/L完整但已是舊E，state已selected B或同C的L2 | 不得以C相同就清B/L2；只允許一般maintenance處理真實已失效的當前狀態 |
| C有值、L缺席 | C本身closed且匹配selected時可終結transport；C仍live時無權猜哪個PLAY logout，僅maintenance |
| C/L任一組合不一致、或C缺席 | 不補current player/listener；沒有精確終結權，只做安全的maintenance |
| C/L都null | 不作clear-all，僅maintenance |

Partial witness不是默認認領當前epoch。Late LoggingOut(C,L1)不能終結(C,L2)。同C在CONFIGURATION期间没有LoggingOut仍由listener變更正確失效；不能為等待logout讓舊state一直connected。

Adapter僅從event原player提取其listener，不retained event或player。若locked版本在某條logout路徑無法提供該witness，使用上述partial規則，不新增欄位到platform event。

### §67.19 Main tasks、enqueue失敗與failure isolation

正常OPEN catalog仍由NETWORK prepare返回task，再以既有context.enqueueWork提交main。PREOPEN不增加每packet task；matching open回傳至多一個原drain。Returned task在main直接執行不改NETWORK registrar。

Task/run/cancel/release必須使用其無live-reference E-token與captured published generation，並在真正bind/present前核對owner現在的C/L仍current。Token identity相同但平台L已換仍不能執行；new L2 catalog即使byte-identical也不等於L1 reservation。

舊finally不能釋放新pre-open/mailbox或重置其charge。Failed enqueue只釋放自己尚有ownership的reservation。合法後續candidate不能被舊release取消。

Open、world-init、resource bind與execution failures保持既有RuntimeException/Error政策：必要authoritative cleanup先於optional diagnostic，primary identity不被secondary取代；不補印成功、不reload、不重送gameplay。Back-end clear無成功證據時，不能發出CLEARED或開放新epoch。

### §67.20 Event、world、resource及server政策

Event preparation的新增限制是exact E guard，且只能OPEN/connected/published當前generation進入原budget/reservation。PREOPEN、OPENING、CONFIGURING、RETIRING不保存pre-open event，也不分配正常accepted sequence。

World、resource、catalog與PLAY generation仍分開。一般world/player replacement不等於PLAY listener換代；PLAY re-entry也不能沿用L1世界旗標或installed接受。Resource reload不丟掉仍合法E的pre-open catalog，也不充當first-login恢復手段。

Server catalog authority、送出政策、submission-ready語意均不改；client-applied與transport-submitted分開。不得新增server resend/ACK、修改listener網路註冊到MAIN、增wire epoch或要求玩家手動reload。S5 input/provisioning仍按§63/§66，不因catalog尚未ready新增另一份client authorization。

### §67.21 Implementation與direct-consumer範圍

後續S5-R2至少核對P8ClientPayloadHandlers、P8ClientPayloadDispatchPort、P8ClientPayloadDispatchFactory、P8ClientPresentationState、P8ClientPresentationLifecycle及其task/transition helpers；相關unit/retention/API/GameTest/client fixtures同步exact signatures與例外。

只批准state一個Connection、一個PLAY-listener witness與lifecycle一個generation-qualified flag的明確欄位角色；不豁免整個P8 package或所有listener references。Common-safe的ICommonPacketListener可用，不因此使common classes持有Minecraft/LocalPlayer/ClientLevel型別。

新增public bridge、persistent schema、wire field與registry均為0。舊無身份production overload全部移除或替換，不留test convenience可被production誤用。Test模型/fixture不靠反射改platform private fields或假的global current listener冒充真正context交接。

## §68 P10-A1 — DATA-DRIVEN TEMPLATE AND EXECUTION SCOPE AMENDMENT

**ADOPTED PRODUCT DECISION — REPOSITORY AUTHORITY MATERIAL**
**CLOSURE-EFFECTIVE ONLY AFTER LOCAL ACCEPTANCE, COMMIT, REQUIRED CI, AND CANONICAL INTEGRATION**

本節記錄本次批准採用的 P10 產品決策；只有對應採用版本完成必要本地接受、repository commit、required CI 與 canonical integration 後，才可在結案紀錄宣告 closure-effective。將本節寫入 architecture 本身不表示 P10 runtime 已實作，也不表示本節要求的產品功能測試已通過。

### §68.1 身分、來源與採用效力

| 項目 | 固定值 |
|---|---|
| Repository baseline | commit `ead9c1e5b556d81b1813598ef1094ee59d672688` |
| Baseline tree | `ac42659c7a5f2fb170ad548d47589ad3f0fecd80` |
| Baseline sole parent | `aad3f3d9bd20190c11107a49e4d2295c2469b16c` |

| Product platform | Minecraft `1.21.1` / NeoForge `21.1.241` / Java `21` |
| Adoption status | Product content approved；repository adoption closure remains conditional on local acceptance, commit, required CI, and canonical integration |

本節只在 §68.14 ledger 明列的範圍內，為 prospective P10 template loading、明確 template-backed 玩家提交，以及依本節接受的 revision 執行，窄幅取代較早 authority。它不追溯修改 P9 closure／qualification evidence，不改寫任何既存 Store bytes，也不改變未列入 ledger 的 §§1–67 要求。

來源地位固定為：

- **EXISTING REQUIREMENT**：H5與既有 frozen/amendment規格已生效內容；
- **REPORTED FINDING**：P10-RO1或固定 source tree的唯讀觀察；
- **ADOPTED DECISION**：本 §68 經本次產品確認採用的新產品選擇；不得冒稱為舊 H5 已存在的 requirement，其 closure-effective 狀態仍受本節開頭條件約束。

### §68.2 Scope、目的與明確不變項

P10 的產品目的，是用一個 bounded server datapack template 取代 starter content 的 Java construction source，同時仍由正常玩家明確操作、既有 Draft／submission／Store、exact reference及原 P5/P6 runtime path產生真正 gameplay 結果。資源 template 是系統內容，不是玩家持久化資料的第二份真相。

本節採用的 flow 為：

```text
one fixed effective datapack JSON
  -> bounded parse + identity-free immutable template body
  -> current/LKG snapshot publication
  -> explicit /gramarye starter by the player
  -> server-supplied SkillId/base + normal SkillDraft
  -> existing authoritative submission
  -> immutable Store revision + Attachment latest/equipped
  -> existing P7 intent -> P5 exact revision -> P6 -> world/P8
```

下列責任保持不變：

1. Store 是 owner及 committed `SkillDocument` revision的唯一真相；Attachment仍只擁有 Draft、latest與equipped mutable routes。
2. Java Trigger/Action descriptor registry在啟動後凍結；template只能選擇既有註冊型別，不能從 JSON 註冊 Java behavior。
3. Resolver、payload migration、semantic analyzer、projector及正式 submission是唯一 legality truth；不得建立 template 專用寬鬆 validator。
4. Client仍只送 slot/sequence intent；不得從 JSON、packet或client取得 damage、mana、geometry、hit或revision authority。
5. Action不直接改world；P5/P6 ordered execution、ManaTransactionService、P8 applied-fact isolation與dedicated-server classloading保持。
6. Reload/snapshot publication不得建立、改寫、刪除玩家 Draft/revision/latest/equipped，不得啟動runtime instance。
7. P11長期restart／多人／replay完整矩陣不提前移入P10；但本節直接改到的owner、submission、revision、reload及exact-reference invariants須在P10回歸。

### §68.3 本節採用的完整產品模型

本節採用下列五項相依決策：

1. P10 必須證明 gameplay parameter 資料驅動；第一個且唯一擴充的 gameplay field 是 damage magnitude，離散集合恰為 `{4000,5000}`。Appearance variability可作補充，不能代替gameplay proof。
2. 唯一 normal-player入口仍是 permission-0 `/gramarye starter`，但成為固定template的create-or-update；同一玩家沿用同一 deterministic SkillId。
3. 第一版只有一個固定identity-free resource、沒有outer template schema或directory catalog；所有bounds在§68.7封閉。
4. P10採one-entry whole-snapshot publication與明示cross-generation LKG；LKG每次使用前仍須在current context重驗。
5. `/skill validate template <resource_location>` 是permission level 2、read-only、bounded operator診斷；正常玩家取得仍完全分離。

### §68.4 Owner、階段與 side-effect 邊界

| 階段 | 唯一責任 owner | 輸入與輸出 | Side effects |
|---|---|---|---|
| Resource read / prepare | root-owned P10 template service的實際reload prepare執行體 | 捕獲的epoch／marker先作current檢查並nonblocking取得唯一reader slot；只有成功owner可把一個effective resource stream → bounded bytes → strict structural candidate或bounded rejection | listener註冊、排程或尚未進入prepare不持有slot；owner在正常或異常terminal恰好一次釋放自己的slot；不碰ServerPlayer、Store、Attachment、world、runtime，不publish active |
| Apply / stage | 同一service的game/application-thread portion | decoded candidate + exact installed-resources identity的staged record | 只替換至多一個staged candidate；不成為active |
| Post-install validation | 明確root coordinator +既有production resolver/analyzer/projector rules + root policy/P8 availability | staged identity-free body → submittable current-context result | 無玩家 mutation；產生 publish/LKG decision |
| Snapshot publication | P10 service | one immutable body + `CURRENT|LKG|UNAVAILABLE`狀態 | 原子換 active reference或保留舊active；不碰玩家狀態 |
| `/skill validate` | server command +同一read-only validation route | active body及current context → bounded diagnostics | 零 Draft/Store/equip/reload/runtime/world side effect |
| Draft materialization | `/gramarye starter` server-thread operation | captured active body + server deterministic identity/base → normal `SkillDraft` | 只有確定需提交時才可能 `putDraft` |
| Authoritative submission | 既有 `SkillDefinitionSubmissionService`及Store/Attachment owners | player Draft +一次authoritative policy/context snapshot → immutable revision/latest or typed rejection | 完全沿用既有commit/journal/recovery語意 |
| Equipment | Attachment owner | exact committed/latest reference → slot 0 | final reread後只准 empty或exact observed same-lineage predecessor轉移 |
| Runtime | 既有P7/P5/P6/world/P8 owners | exact stored reference與server intent → effect/applied fact | 不查「latest template」；template不是runtime truth |

Catalog admission與player submission是兩次不同用途的validation。Catalog admission及starter在Draft mutation前取得的是**non-authoritative materialization-eligibility** current-context snapshot，只決定body是否可publish／materialize；不得把它傳入、快取成或冒充submission policy。每次真正submission仍須由既有service在原定coordinate另取該attempt唯一的authoritative `SkillSubmissionPolicySnapshot`並完整重驗。Catalog成功不能取代submission，submission失敗也不回寫snapshot成invalid；兩次觀察之間policy/context改變而使submission拒絕是合法結果，已合法materialize的Draft依既有規則保留。

### §68.5 固定 resource、logical ID與 JSON shape

第一版只認一個logical template ID：

```text
gramarye:starter_bolt_v0
```

其固定physical built-in path為：

```text
data/gramarye/gramarye/skill_templates/starter_bolt_v0.json
```

標準datapack resource priority決定唯一effective resource。相同path存在於多個packs是正常override，不是duplicate entry；只讀最高優先effective resource。若該override無效，不得暗中改讀較低pack。移除external override後，下一次正常reload若使built-in重新成為effective resource，則以一個新candidate正常驗證。

Template ID只由固定resource path決定，JSON內不得宣告另一個ID。現有generic root/node/`DefinitionEnvelope.CODEC`不保證拒絕所有shell extra fields；因此template ingress新增bounded strict parser + exact-key preflight。Parser必須在構建tree的同時、在加入下一value/key/string之前執行effective depth、tree-value與Java-length budgets，於policy+1立即停止；不得先用現有只保證部分bounds的decoder建立unbounded `JsonElement`再事後計數。其輸出tree才進行下列closed-key檢查，再交給既有canonical codecs：

- `nodes`：required array；本P10 slice semantic shape恰為2個ordered nodes；
- `appearance`：required且不得為`null`；built-in canonical value為`{}`；合法decoded fields、ProfileSelection及其runtime availability semantics仍依既有Appearance規則，但unknown/malformed/null不取得persisted tolerant fallback；
- 任何其他top-level field均拒絕，包括`schema_version`、`template_id`、`owner`、`skill_id`、`revision`、`base_revision`、player/session/generation欄位。

每一node為complete `NodeDocument`-style body：

- required `trigger` complete envelope；
- required `action` complete envelope；
- optional `appearance_override`；None必須以欄位省略表示，explicit `null`在template canonical ingress拒絕；
- node shell未知欄位由上述新preflight拒絕；
- envelope shell恰為`type`、`schema_version`、`payload`；這個shell exactness是本節新增的template-ingress規則，不冒稱為現有`DefinitionEnvelope.CODEC`的closed-field保證；既有bounded structural payload preservation保持；
- template adapter只在materialization時把complete envelopes包成present Draft slots，不能假裝此body是已有`SkillDraft.CODEC` wire shape。

Top-level、node、envelope及strict Appearance的任何unknown key、explicit null、wrong type或bounds violation均拒絕whole candidate。Persisted document tolerant-read的`Unparsed`／`Rejected`／fallback只適用既有storage讀取，不適用canonical template ingress。

本template body沒有獨立outer schema/version。它不是Draft schema、Document schema、SkillRevision或storage schema。未來若增加outer shape或directory catalog，須另有scoped authority；不得把本版缺少outer version當成可偷偷加field的許可。

#### §68.5.1 Built-in A

```json
{
  "nodes": [
    {
      "trigger": {
        "type": "gramarye:active_cast",
        "schema_version": 0,
        "payload": {}
      },
      "action": {
        "type": "gramarye:spawn_projectile",
        "schema_version": 0,
        "payload": {"profile_code": 0, "mana_cost": 0}
      }
    },
    {
      "trigger": {
        "type": "gramarye:effect_hit",
        "schema_version": 0,
        "payload": {
          "source_node_index": 0,
          "source_output_ordinal": 0,
          "include_derived": true
        }
      },
      "action": {

        "schema_version": 1,
        "payload": {"magnitude": 4000, "mana_cost": 0}
      }
```
