
Built-in A與P9 golden gameplay/appearance語意相同，但damage envelope使用批准後的current schema 1；因此不冒稱它與歷史P9 V0 envelope逐byte相同。

#### §68.5.2 External datapack B

B保持同一shape、types、schemas、mana、profile、hit、Appearance，只把下列一個JSON value改為：

```json
"magnitude": 5000
```

A→B不修改Java/class/mod JAR。`{4000,5000}`是集合，不是`[4000,5000]`區間；`4001`、`4500`、負數、0、其他正數及P6 ceiling內的其他數字均非本P10產品。

### §68.6 Damage schema、migration與分類

`gramarye:damage`在本節批准後的current payload schema為1。升版理由不是數字5000本身，而是要把新的產品接受epoch與歷史V0「只允許4000/0」語意分開；若原地放寬V0，歷史上非法的V0/5000會在新程式中追溯變合法。

唯一production adjacent migration edge為`V0 → V1`，由既有damage descriptor payload migration plan擁有，規則exact：

1. 輸入必須是closed object，keys恰為`magnitude`與`mana_cost`；兩者均為原codec可接受的exact integer。
2. `magnitude`必須恰為`4000`，`mana_cost`必須恰為`0`。
3. 只有上述輸入可產生語意相同的V1 payload；step不得做generic structural copy。
4. V0/5000、extra/missing key、wrong type或其他value均為migration failure，保留原bounded structural raw作該次classification，不降級為V1 semantic input。

V1 codec仍是closed payload，欄位恰為`magnitude`與`mana_cost`；semantic validator只接受`magnitude ∈ {4000,5000}`且`mana_cost=0`。V1的typed carrier精確重用既有package-private `com.yo1no.gramarye.P9DamageActionPayloadV0` record，不新增`V1` carrier或第二payload type；該Java名稱只表示既有結構來源，不是persisted schema authority，persisted/current schema只由envelope version與`P9DamageActionType`決定。Draft/SkillDocument outer schema保持既有current value；SkillRevision不因schema migration改變；Store中舊V0/4000 revision bytes永不rewrite。讀取舊revision時只在transient resolver中遷移到current typed projection。

分類必須互斥並保留：

| Input | Classification與後果 |
|---|---|
| Resource stream invalid UTF-8、BOM、trailing token、duplicate key、raw/depth/tree/string/payload/Appearance bound violation，或root/node/envelope exact-key／identity-field／outer-shape failure | `DECODE_FAILED`；細因只進bounded sanitized summary code；不得建立partial candidate或另發明implementation-local top-level classification |
| Unknown Trigger/Action type + bounded structural envelope | `UNKNOWN_TYPE`；保留structural proxy供當次診斷／round-trip proof；non-submittable、non-executable |
| Known V0 damage exact 4000/0 | migration成功到V1/4000，再走decode/semantic；舊Store不rewrite |
| Known V0 damage 5000或V0 malformed | `MIGRATION_FAILED`；不得因V1允許5000而追溯接受 |
| Known V1 malformed payload | `DECODE_FAILED`，不是Unknown或migration failure |
| Known schema > 1 | `FUTURE_SCHEMA`；non-submittable，不嘗試down-migration |
| Known schema < 1且缺少、非consecutive或拒絕required adjacent path | `MIGRATION_FAILED`；non-submittable，不直接交current codec |
| Known decoded V1但magnitude不在集合或mana非0 | `SEMANTIC_INVALID` |
| Template Appearance/override有unknown field、explicit null、malformed known field或超界 | `DECODE_FAILED`；whole candidate拒絕。不得在template ingress套用persisted tolerant-read的Unparsed/Rejected/fallback |

Production migration acceptance必須直接證明真實V0/4000→V1/4000、V0/5000失敗、raw failure preservation及future schema；不得以fake V-1或只在test registry的migration替代本次真實edge。Whole-skill migration plan仍唯一且不因本節另建第二份。

一個attempt只有一個top-level classification。`MISSING_REQUIRED_TEMPLATE`、`OVERLAPPING_RELOAD`、`STALE_CANDIDATE`與post-install pessimistic `INTERNAL_FAILURE`是各自控制路徑的exclusive marker；matching P8/current validation context不能提供時，在candidate eligibility pipeline開始前固定為exclusive `CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE`。只有context可用才跑candidate pipeline；其primary採production pipeline依下列固定順序觀察到的**第一個實際fatal production result**，完全獨立於diagnostic collector是否保留該issue：(1) bounded stream/UTF-8/JSON及root/node/envelope/Appearance structural ingress，(2) envelope固定document order `node0.trigger → node0.action → node1.trigger → node1.action`，每個envelope內依`type lookup → schema/future check → adjacent migration → current codec decode → semantic validation`，(3) whole-skill/profile semantic validation。若跨stage需要記住primary，只保留一個fixed classification scalar；它不是另一份retained issue，不保留額外raw、完整issue或第二個collector，也不增加任何既有診斷計數。各stage依§68.6映到`DECODE_FAILED|UNKNOWN_TYPE|FUTURE_SCHEMA|MIGRATION_FAILED|SEMANTIC_INVALID`；後續普通或fatal issues只可作bounded diagnostic collector的輸入，是否實際retained依既有上限，一律不改primary。Collector先達保留上限也不得重定primary，或把其後實際觀察到fatal的不可提交結果變成Ready。Unexpected throwable不使用已累積data issue，固定保留／覆寫為`INTERNAL_FAILURE`並同一object傳播。Catalog、latest-attempt與read-only validate必須共用此排序與同一production failure facts，不能按hash/map traversal、collector retention或implementation便利任選。

### §68.7 Bounds與記憶體角色

所有limits均inclusive；`limit+1`必須拒絕。Policy admission先於publication；hard ceiling永不可被config提高。第一版尚未提供template-specific config，因此下表的policy值固定採現有document/payload defaults。

| Coordinate | Policy admission | Hard ceiling | 計量與owner |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| one effective template raw bytes | `262,144` | `1,048,576` | 從resource stream讀取；decode前，以最多hard+1 bytes的bounded read判定 |
| effective resource count | `1` | `1` | direct lookup固定ID；不enumerate directory |
| per-reload catalog aggregate raw bytes | `262,144` | `1,048,576` | 因effective count恰為1，aggregate等於per-resource；不能另套Store quota |
| whole template JSON depth | `32` | `64` | root depth=1；short-circuit |
| whole template parsed tree values | `16,384` | `65,536` | root/object members/array elements沿既有tree coordinate計數；新bounded parser在構樹前置增量檢查effective policy，value 16,385不配置／不加入 |
| string或object key length | `256` | `1,024` | Java `String.length()` coordinate；新bounded parser在保留token前檢查，ResourceLocation自身更窄規則仍適用 |
| node count | semantic exact `2`；generic policy `64` | `256` | decode bounded後，P10 supported shape再要求exact two |
| one DefinitionEnvelope canonical payload bytes | `65,536` | `262,144` | strict parse後payload subtree使用既有`StrictJsonTreeCodec` exact canonical encoding semantics：object keys以Java `String.compareTo`升冪、array order保持、strict UTF-8無BOM、`JsonWriter` non-lenient且serialize-null；每個subtree獨立，whole original-stream limit仍同時適用 |
| top canonical Appearance subtree relative depth | location-effective policy `31` | intrinsic codec hard `32` | subtree root=1；它位於whole-template depth 2，故whole policy 32先把relative maximum縮為31；同時受whole hard64 |
| one node canonical Appearance override subtree relative depth | location-effective policy `29` | intrinsic codec hard `32` | subtree root=1；它位於root→nodes array→node→override的whole depth 4，故whole policy 32先把relative maximum縮為29；同時受whole hard64 |
| one canonical Appearance/override subtree values | effective `1,024` | `1,024` | strict Appearance codec hard bound；top + two possible overrides各自檢查，另同時受whole-template tree policy/hard |
| transient validation issues | existing bounded collector | `1,024` | 每次pipeline run；不是全部對command輸出；§68.6的fixed primary classification scalar不作為collector issue計數 |
| retained installed-attempt status records | `1` | `1` | 只保留latest installed attempt；後來attempt原子替換先前status，不保留history/raw；classification是一個由第一個實際fatal production result決定、與summary retention分離的fixed scalar；accepted exact shape為fixed `ACCEPTED`、retainedCount=`0`、summaries empty、`retainedButNotSummarized=0`、`upstreamTruncated=false` |
| summaries in a rejected attempt | `16` | `16` | deterministic pipeline order取collector實際保留的前16；每個是一個sanitized rendered code/path summary；另保留fixed classification、原collector exact retained-count、`retainedButNotSummarized=retainedCount-summaryCount`（exact `0..1,008`）及該axis的`upstreamTruncated` boolean；classification不得由「first retained」反向導出，後者為true時不得宣稱知道collector ceiling外的總遺漏數 |
| one rendered diagnostic component | `1,024` Java UTF-16 code units | `1,024` Java UTF-16 code units | 以送出前`Component.getString().length()`計量；不輸出raw、stack、host path；超出安全截斷並標truncated |
| retained summary aggregate | `16,384` Java UTF-16 code units | `16,384` Java UTF-16 code units | 16個retained summary Java `String.length()`之和；fixed scalar metadata另計，不保留任意string |
| command output | 1 status + 最多16 issue components | `17` components / `17,408` Java UTF-16 code units | 每個component以送出前`Component.getString().length()`、aggregate取其和；component separators/wire bytes/client-localized expansion不在此coordinate；current revalidation issues先、latest-attempt summaries後，共享first-16 budget；header的known `displayOmitted=currentRetainedCount+lastAttemptRetainedCount-totalPrintedIssueComponents`，exact `0..2,032`，`upstreamTruncated`為兩axis flags的OR |
| retained active bodies | `1` | `1` | immutable identity-free body；LKG就是active，不是第三份 |
| retained staged candidates | `1` | `1` | exact resources identity；新stage取代/丟棄stale，不累積history |
| admitted prepare readers | `1` | `1` | process/service-wide、跨lifecycle epochs的nonblocking single-flight ownership slot；只由epoch／marker仍current的實際prepare執行體在body開始時原子compare-and-acquire，listener註冊、排程、未進入或未取得者均不占slot；overlapping attempt不得開啟resource stream或釋放他人slot；stop只使實際owner的stage／publish authority失效，不在其body真正terminal前騰空slot |
| canonical payload encode scratch | `1` | `1` | 四個envelopes依node/order sequential量測；同時最多一個最多`262,145` bytes的hard+1 scratch，判定後立即釋放，禁止parallel encode |

Service steady state至多保留一個active body與一個staged candidate；兩者各自只保留bounded structural body及原始admission-length scalar，不保留原始resource bytes。兩份body的logical structural-tree charge各至多16,384 values、合計32,768；`524,288`只是兩次原始stream admission-length charge上界，不是retained raw bytes。

每次`AddReloadListenerEvent`只建立並捕獲該次reload的private lifecycle epoch、latest-expected reload marker與listener；註冊、排程及尚未進入的prepare工作都不預先取得reader ownership slot。實際prepare執行體開始後，先以捕獲的epoch／marker對同一service state作current檢查，再以nonblocking的原子compare-and-acquire取得唯一slot；stale epoch／marker直接drop，不宣稱latest、不寫status且不占slot，較晚才得到CPU的舊prepare也不得奪回已被新reload supersede的marker。只有取得成功且marker仍current的owner可open resource stream；若slot已由另一個實際reader占用，該current valid attempt以自己的exact resources identity／marker產生bounded `OVERLAPPING_RELOAD` rejected result，不open/read resource，也不得釋放他人的slot。成功owner把resource open、bounded read、parse與candidate建立包在同一實際執行體的terminal responsibility內，正常或throwable terminal都恰好一次釋放自己的buffer/tree/scratch與slot；未進入或未取得slot的attempt沒有reader slot，也不得執行slot release。Release只騰空ownership，不授權stage/publish、不自動排程補讀。因而任何時點至多一個實際admitted prepare reader；從未開始的舊prepare不會留下occupied slot。正常prepare期間可短暫存在一個最多1,048,577-byte read buffer用來證明hard+1；超hard或policy後立即丟棄，不建立tree；parse成功後、開始canonical payload量測前也必須釋放該original-stream buffer。

因上述構樹期間budget是admission前置條件，通過policy後一個成功admitted actual prepare reader至多同時持有一個16,384-value parsed source tree與一份合計不超過16,384-value的derived bounded structural candidate；加上active及staged各16,384，跨service的logical structural-tree high-water至多65,536 values。Defensive payload/Appearance copies須計入derived charge，不能取得額外unbounded allowance；typed validation projection另受exact two nodes、每payload byte及1,024 transient-facts bounds。每payload canonical-byte量測按固定node0-trigger、node0-action、node1-trigger、node1-action順序執行，只有一個最多262,145-byte scratch，不能保留前一payload bytes或parallel encode。這些是logical input/retention charges，不是Java object/heap byte證明。完成publish/reject後不得保留read buffer/encode scratch、ResourceManager、old Profile context或完整rejected raw。Unknown structural raw只在當次bounded candidate classification／round-trip proof所需的body中存在；candidate確定被拒後，只保留一份latest installed-attempt status record的fixed classification scalar、既有bounded scalar metadata與summaries，不保留rejected raw、完整issue或第二個collector。

16-summary是本節**ADOPTED DECISION**的operator-diagnostic bound，不從四個envelopes推導，也不冒稱已有heap或runtime qualification；root/Appearance及其他錯誤共用同一first-16 budget。Primary classification scalar不是summary、retained issue或output component；保存它不提高1,024／16／component／aggregate上限，也不改`retainedCount`、`retainedButNotSummarized`、`displayOmitted`或`upstreamTruncated`公式。

### §68.8 Snapshot publication與 LKG policy

P10第一版是one-entry whole-snapshot：candidate的任一required部分失敗，整份candidate不publish；不存在「valid node先publish」或per-entry混合generation。

Loader須使用具prepare/apply barrier且可原子stage一個candidate的platform reload-listener模型；不得使用會逐檔catch/log/skip而把required template缺失掩成成功的per-file permissive JSON listener語意。Missing、bounded parse、unknown、migration、decode及semantic等**預期產品資料錯誤**轉成`RejectedCandidate`，可讓platform resources正常安裝後由本節LKG政策裁決。

Failure phase必須分開。Platform/global reload在resources installation/full-sync前因本listener或其他listener的unexpected exception/`Error`失敗時，新resources未生效，舊active保持`CURRENT`；既有platform沒有global failure callback，因此已stage的至多一筆candidate不宣稱立即釋放，而是inaccessible，直到下一次stage replacement或server stop才釋放，且任何不matching current resources identity的candidate永不可publish。Staging只在staged record內攜帶bounded result，不能改operator-visible latest **installed** attempt；pre-install failure後validate仍看前一installed attempt。相反地，root coordinator一進入「resources已安裝、full-sync post-install開始」邊界，就必須在呼叫任何P8 matching activation/result或P10 validation/publication之前，原子把舊P10 active origin標為`LKG`（無舊active則`UNAVAILABLE`），並為目前exact resources identity安裝一份fixed `INTERNAL_FAILURE` pessimistic latest-attempt marker（零raw、零任意detail）。P8與P10正常terminal會把該marker覆寫為`ACCEPTED`或實際expected rejection/context分類；若任一步fault，marker保留，故operator不得看到上一代`ACCEPTED`冒充目前attempt。此後P8、root handoff或P10的`RuntimeException`/`Error`都不能回溯成platform reload rollback：失敗時不publish/promote candidate、不呼叫P5 completion/reopen，並依既有same-object/fault policy傳播；不得讓舊A殘留`CURRENT`，也不得把unexpected fault正規化成普通invalid template。

Full reload的唯一server-thread owner是§68.14指定的root callback：先執行上述post-install P10 origin降級，再取得§68.8.1 P8 matching activation的closed result，再由P10消費該exact結果作publish、LKG或STALE_CONTEXT決定；只有P8與P10兩步正常terminal後才呼叫P5 reload completion/reopen。Expected live P8 unavailable/exhausted是正常terminal而非startup成功：它允許P5完成reopen，但P10保持LKG/UNAVAILABLE且starter/validate因`STALE_CONTEXT`不可提交。P8原本獨立的`player == null` activation branch由此窄幅取代；`player != null`仍只由P8排程既有active catalog給該player，對P10不得stage、validate、publish、改origin或更換diagnostics。每次成功P10 publication，即使new body與old body content-equal，也配置fresh private publication token/object identity；body equality不得充當operation pin。

#### §68.8.1 Exact P8 root full-sync handoff

為避免root從P8 private fields推測activation結果，`P8ServerPresentationService`在保持§61.17全部既有members及§62.5 `captureAppearanceResolutionSnapshot()`不變的前提下，exact新增一個package-private root lifecycle member與一個package-private nested closed enum：

```java
P8RootFullSyncOutcome activateMatchingCandidateForRoot(MinecraftServer server);

enum P8RootFullSyncOutcome {
    ACTIVATED_CURRENT,
    NO_MATCHING_CANDIDATE,
    GENERATION_EXHAUSTED
}
```

此enum是`P8ServerPresentationService`的nested member，不是新top-level declaration。Method只准由同root package的唯一full-sync coordinator在`OnDatapackSyncEvent#getPlayer() == null`、server logic thread、post-install pessimistic transition之後同步呼叫一次；它從exact `server.getServerResources().managers()`在service內部構造current resources identity，不接受caller提供token、candidate、catalog或ResourceManager。Wrong server/thread/lifecycle及unexpected `RuntimeException`／`Error`不是normal enum value，依既有same-object/fault policy傳播。

`ACTIVATED_CURRENT`表示matching candidate已依P8既有generation、atomic publication、connection scheduling與diagnostic規則成為current active；`NO_MATCHING_CANDIDATE`表示沒有matching current-resources staged candidate；`GENERATION_EXHAUSTED`表示matching candidate存在但P8 generation不能再前進，並沿用既有pending-release語意。後兩者是§68.8所稱expected live unavailable，P10不得取用old P8 availability假Ready。Result不攜帶catalog、generation、profile/body、player、resource identity或任意detail，也不得保存或供其他consumer取得。

原P8 `handleDatapackSync`只保留`player != null` branch；`player == null`時不得另行activation、不得呼叫本member，避免double activation。這是對§61.17／§62.5／§62.15／§62.16「exact service surface／唯一capture extension／exact P8S2 consumer／no internal bridge」的單一scoped supersession：只允許上述root-only lifecycle handoff。`P8ServerPresentationService`自身的public/protected operation/field delta=0，public top-level/API可取得面delta=0；package-private nested enum依Java語意精確新增3個product-declared `public static final` enum-constant fields，compiler-generated `values()`／`valueOf(String)`不列入product-declared count。除此之外一般internal bridge仍為0。

| Situation | Active state | Player submission availability | Retained diagnostics／其他效果 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ServerStartedEvent`的P8 initial activation缺matching candidate、generation capacity exhausted或其他不可用 | P10 initial decision不得把它降級；P10保持/清回empty | 不可提交 | 完整保留§61.15 hard-fail；P5不得進`RUNNING`，server不得因P10政策繼續啟動 |
| P8 initial activation成功，且P10 first load valid | publish body as `CURRENT` | current-context重驗通過後可提交 | 清除舊rejection summary；server可繼續啟動 |
| P8 initial activation成功，但P10 first load missing/invalid/unknown/future/malformed/semantic invalid | no active，`UNAVAILABLE` | 不可提交；starter return 0 | 保留一份bounded latest installed-attempt status record（fixed classification scalar + bounded diagnostics）；只有此情形server其他系統可繼續啟動 |
| Later reload valid B | atomic replace A→B，B=`CURRENT` | B current-context重驗後可提交 | A snapshot可在無同步reader後釋放；零玩家mutation |
| Later reload invalid B | retain A，A=`LKG`，B不是active | A只有在當前context重驗通過時可提交 | 保留B的一份bounded latest installed-attempt status record；明示origin mismatch |
| Platform reload在resources installation/full-sync前整體失敗 | 舊A仍為`CURRENT`；至多一筆staged candidate inaccessible | 依舊A current-context規則 | 新resources未安裝；operator-visible latest installed attempt保持上一筆；staged只可由下次stage replacement或stop釋放，永不因identity mismatch而publish |
| Resources已安裝，P8 activation/root handoff/P10 validation-publication任一步unexpected fault | root在第一個post-install call前已把舊A標`LKG`；無A則`UNAVAILABLE`；candidate不publish | 不可提交直到一個正常current-context重驗／後續成功publication；P5 admission保持closed | current resources identity的latest attempt固定為`INTERNAL_FAILURE`且零raw；same-object/fault policy；不得稱platform rollback或ordinary rejected candidate |
| Resources已安裝但沒有matching exact-resources candidate，或只有stale candidate | retain A並標`LKG`；無A則`UNAVAILABLE` | current-context規則；不得用stale candidate | `STALE_CANDIDATE` bounded diagnostic |
| **Live full-sync** matching P8 catalog generation exhausted或P8沒有matching-current publication | retain A並標`LKG`；無A則`UNAVAILABLE` | verdict=`STALE_CONTEXT`，return 0 | P10沒有自己的numeric exhaustion；不得用old P8 availability假Ready；這是expected live terminal，P10裁決後root仍可完成P5 reopen |
| Player-specific datapack sync (`player != null`) | P10 state完全不變 | 完全不變 | 只保留既有P8 player scheduling；零P10 stage/validate/publish/diagnostic mutation |
| Effective resource removed but lower built-in revealed | 把revealed built-in當普通new candidate | valid則CURRENT；invalid則依LKG | 不稱duplicate或silent fallback |
| Truly no effective required resource | retainLKG或UNAVAILABLE | 依current-context LKG rule；無LKG則拒絕 | `MISSING_REQUIRED_TEMPLATE` |
| Any partial entry invalid | whole candidate rejected | 不可使用candidate中其餘部分 | 無partial publication |
| LKG在新policy/P8 availability下不再合法 | publication state仍為`LKG`，另得`STALE_CONTEXT` eligibility verdict | return 0；不得materialize Draft | stale不是第四種publication state；每次validate/starter可在後續current context再重驗 |
| Stale/superseded staged candidate | drop | 無 | 不覆蓋matching current candidate或active |
| P10 generation exhaustion | 不存在此產品狀態 | 無特殊fallback | P10不建立numeric public/persistent generation；使用exact staged resources identity及每次publication的fresh private token identity |
| Player SkillRevision / Attachment mutation generation exhausted | snapshot不變 | 沿用existing typed rejection，return 0 | 不overflow、wrap、reuse或自動reclaim |
| `ServerStoppingEvent` | 依P5→P8→P10 LOWEST registration order，P10原子使lifecycle epoch、current/latest expected reload marker及已實際取得slot owner的**stage／publish authority**失效，並清active/staged/diagnostics；只有body仍在執行的actual owner保持global slot至真正terminal release | unavailable | Store revisions不受影響；已在background的actual old reader可跑到terminal但只能釋放自己的buffer/tree/scratch/slot，永不可stage/publish；Future已cancelled／completed或server stopped都不是body已退出的證據，stop不得提前騰空slot；尚未進入或未取得slot的工作不持有slot |
| `ServerStoppedEvent` | 依同一P5→P8→P10順序idempotently再assert/clear lifecycle epoch、active/staged、diagnostics與markers；仍由live actual reader持有的global slot不在此清除，必須等exact owner body真正terminal | unavailable | duplicate callback不得重釋放或復活；仍在晚到的old-epoch owner只能drop/release自己的資源；未進入工作沒有slot或finally回收責任 |
| Server restart | 在任何新reload listener registration前建立fresh、與舊值不相等的private lifecycle epoch；新listener建立marker但不占reader slot，memory state從empty開始，以當前effective resource重建 | P8 initial先成功後，P10初次validation決定CURRENT/UNAVAILABLE | 不持久化LKG；舊reader不能stage；新epoch實際prepare body進入時，只有仍在執行的old actual owner才使其得到`OVERLAPPING_RELOAD`且不得open stream；舊工作未開始或old owner已真正terminal時可正常嘗試acquire。舊owner後來release不自動重讀，須下一次supported reload；舊player revisions仍在Store |

`CURRENT`表示active body來自目前已安裝的resource set且通過publication-time validation；`LKG`表示active body來自較早成功resource set，新的effective candidate已被拒或post-install decision未完成。兩者在真正player submission前都要重新使用當前root policy/P8 availability驗證。Publication-time PASS不是永久權限。Service只保留一份latest installed-attempt status record，其fixed classification scalar與bounded diagnostic retention分離；後來attempt原子替換前一份，成功publication清除rejection summaries但仍記錄fixed `ACCEPTED` classification。

Snapshot保存identity-free immutable body：ordered nodes、DefinitionEnvelope的type/schema/bounded structural raw payload，以及Appearance/override immutable values。它不保存resolved descriptor instance projection、ValidationContext、policy snapshot、Profile snapshot、ResourceManager、player、world或Store reference。因而跨generation保留A不等於保留A時的registry/profile權限。

P10 listener只捕獲exact private lifecycle epoch與reload marker；只有actual prepare body通過current marker檢查並成功原子取得service-wide slot時，才建立single-flight reader ownership identity。Stale、尚未進入或acquire失敗的body均沒有ownership，不能open stream，也不得release他人slot。`ServerStoppingEvent`使epoch及actual owner的stage／publish authority失效，但不得中斷／誤殺platform executor，也不得因Future已cancelled／completed或server已stopped就在body真正terminal前清空global slot。任何舊actual owner晚到，不論成功、普通reject或throwable terminal，都只可在自己的ownership下恰好一次釋放read buffer、parsed/derived tree及encode scratch，再恰好一次release自己的slot；epoch／marker／resources mismatch禁止寫入staged、latest-attempt或active。`ServerStoppedEvent`重做同一idempotent state clear，restart先配置fresh non-equal epoch與marker而不占slot；新epoch actual prepare body只有在old actual owner仍執行時才得到bounded `OVERLAPPING_RELOAD`且不open stream，old work未進入或owner已terminal時則可正常acquire。Old owner後來release只騰空ownership，不排程或開啟補讀；只有下一次platform-supported reload可取得resource。因而跨stop/restart仍是全service最多一個實際reader與§68.7同一high-water，舊reader也永不能在新server世代restage或奪回latest marker。

### §68.9 Player operation的 snapshot與current-context政策

一次`/gramarye starter`操作遵循下列精確規則：

1. 先完成source/server-thread/player identity檢查；未通過時不capture、不mutation。
2. 在server logic thread原子捕獲一次active immutable body、fresh private publication token、固定entry、`CURRENT|LKG` relation及latest-attempt metadata。整次操作不得中途分開重讀catalog/body/origin或切換到新body；content equality及cached body object均不能代替token identity。
3. 在任何Draft／equipment mutation前，用當前root policy snapshot與matching-current P8 availability透過既有production validation rules做non-authoritative materialization-eligibility重驗，並確認captured publication token仍是service current active。CURRENT或LKG任一body若stale/unavailable均回`STALE_CONTEXT`/0；token改變回`SNAPSHOT_CHANGED`/0，兩者都零mutation且不自動retry。
4. Reload prepare可在background進行，但publication在同一server thread；正常同步command因此只能完整看見publish前或publish後狀態，不會在operation中間切換。
5. 從capture至terminal result必須是同一server-thread、non-yield、non-await operation；本節不授權async resume。因publication也在同一thread，第一次mutation後不可能interleave。若未來要引入yield/await，須另有authority定義pre-mutation token recheck與post-mutation pinned completion；不得在本版半途重讀／重送或變成background ACK/persistent template transaction。
6. 前述重驗只保護materialization eligibility。實際`submit`仍按既有順序在authority/base checks後另取該submission attempt唯一的current `SkillSubmissionPolicySnapshot`並正式重驗；只此第二份snapshot具有submission authority，不得重用第3步snapshot。若它拒絕，Store不commit，已合法materialize的Draft依既有規則保留供明確重試。
7. 成功／already-current訊息必須包含`CURRENT`或`LKG`，讓玩家知道本次使用哪一種active資料；使用LKG時不得說新candidate已生效。

### §68.10 `/gramarye starter` create-or-update contract

Command literal、permission及合法source保持：permission level 0；只接受在current server logic thread執行命令的exact connected `ServerPlayer`本人；FakePlayer、console、command block、absent/other player拒絕。固定slot仍是0，fixed template仍是`gramarye:starter_bolt_v0`。

玩家SkillId固定沿用`P9StarterSkillIdentityV0.forPlayer(playerUuid)`。它只是reserved starter lineage route，不是credential；owner仍由authenticated player/Store決定。Template ID相同從不表示玩家已取得最新content。

這是對舊recovery surface的明示相容性取捨：§63.5原本在slot empty時掃描本人bounded latest routes，恰一個canonical semantic match即使位於其他SkillId也可重用。P10後該arbitrary-ID scan取消；其他ID的既有revision、latest與equipment不刪不改，但`/gramarye starter`不尋找、不接管、不裝備它們，只處理deterministic lineage。`VALID_CURRENT_NON_TARGET`專指slot exact ref就是同一deterministic SkillId的authoritative latest、owner-valid/decodable/supported，但其完整content不同於captured target；`VALID_OLDER`專指同lineage下仍retained、owner-valid、decodable且supported的nonlatest exact reference；`stale`專指dangling/reclaimed/missing、undecodable、wrong-owner或unsupported reference，三者不得混稱。

#### §68.10.1 Content equivalence與兩個 matcher

三個概念不得混用：

1. **Legacy P9 canonical fingerprint**：保留歷史`StarterGameplayFingerprintV0` exact semantics，damage=4000；P9 evidence與舊revision辨識仍可使用。
2. **P10 supported-starter predicate**：在正式resolve/validation後，要求exact two-node graph、type IDs、profile0、hit0/0/true、mana0及damage current value∈`{4000,5000}`；用來防止deterministic route被任意content占用。Appearance不決定supported gameplay shape。
3. **Template content equivalence**：決定是否真的需要successor。兩邊先經existing production migration/resolution與canonical normalization，然後比較identity-free完整stored content：ordered node envelopes的type、current schema及payload structural value，以及top/node Appearance。排除SkillId、owner、SkillRevision、Draft base、template/snapshot identity、diagnostics、JSON whitespace/key order。任一migration/decode不能完成即fail closed。

不得只比template ID、raw resource bytes、legacy gameplay fingerprint或只含gameplay的runtime projection。尤其Appearance差異是合法persistent content差異，必須在明確操作時產生successor，而不能被gameplay fingerprint吞掉。

#### §68.10.2 操作真值表

判定順序是契約的一部分：source/active eligibility → slot exact read → deterministic Store owner/latest classification → target-vs-latest content classification →（只有將發生mutation時）pre-existing recovery gate → command-owned Draft route/revision admission → Draft publication → formal submission-owned policy/quota/Store/journal admission → final exact-slot reread。`already_current`在任何mutation gate之前terminal；只有確定需要successor後才做安全的revision-exhaustion與Draft-route-count檢查。Policy quota與Store history/revision、submission transition、journal及Store-persistence capacity只由formal submission的唯一authoritative snapshot／owners判定；command只處理其自己`putDraft`的Draft-persistence／Attachment-capacity結果，不得另做會改變結果階段的authoritative preflight。Pre-existing recovery gate在本command第一次mutation前恰好觀察一次；不得用本次submission稍後新建的journal反過來阻擋同一次command的final equip。

| Observed condition | Command result | Draft / Store / Attachment effect |
|---|---|---|
| wrong thread/source、non-self、FakePlayer、disconnected | `source_rejected`（where platform permits）；return `0` | zero mutation |
| active template absent/UNAVAILABLE，或captured CURRENT/LKG任一body在current context stale | `template_unavailable`或`STALE_CONTEXT`；return `0` | no Draft/revision/equip |
| initial authoritative Attachment slot0 read不能產生exact `empty|reference` result | `attachment_unavailable`；return `0` | zero mutation；不猜empty、不讀寫Draft/Store/equip |
| slot0是deterministic lineage的owner-valid、decodable、supported **exact authoritative latest**，且latest完整content=target | `already_current(CURRENT|LKG)`；return `1` | absolute zero mutation；不執行recovery gate，也不讀、replace、delete或rebase Draft；任何existing Draft byte-for-byte保留，即使有未提交內容 |
| slot0是owner-valid、decodable、supported exact authoritative latest，但latest完整content≠target | 分類`VALID_CURRENT_NON_TARGET`，記錄該exact value並進入successor update | successor base與final CAS expected value都是captured authoritative latest |
| slot0為其他SkillId | `slot_occupied`；return `0` | 不以相似content接管，不掃描任意player revisions，不fallback slot |
| slot0為deterministic SkillId但exact ref dangling/reclaimed/missing、undecodable、wrong-owner或unsupported | opaque `slot_unavailable`；return `0` | 不洩漏actual owner/latest，不清slot；此為stale，不是VALID_OLDER |
| slot0為deterministic `VALID_OLDER` | 記錄該exact observed value，繼續依authoritative Store latest判定same-content re-equip或successor | successor base永遠是authoritative latest，不是slot older；final CAS expected value仍是captured VALID_OLDER |
| slot0 empty | 記錄empty expected value並繼續 | 不掃描其他SkillId；final CAS只准仍empty |
| deterministic Store owner/latest/revision authoritative read不能產生完整typed result | `store_unavailable`；return `0` | pre-Draft zero mutation；不把unavailable猜成absent、empty或collision |
| deterministic Store identity存在但owner不是command player | opaque `starter_identity_not_authorized`；return `0` | pre-Draft zero mutation；不得adopt、overwrite或洩漏owner |
| deterministic Store identity有state但latest missing／inconsistent，或latest undecodable／unsupported | `starter_identity_unavailable_or_collision`；return `0` | pre-Draft zero mutation；不得把template蓋過existing content |
| deterministic Store latest owner-valid/supported且完整content=target；slot empty或VALID_OLDER | no successor；進入recovery-gated re-equip | Draft完全不讀改；只在final rere讀仍等於captured empty/VALID_OLDER時equip exact latest |
| deterministic Store latest owner-valid/supported但完整content≠target；slot captured empty、VALID_CURRENT_NON_TARGET或VALID_OLDER | 需要successor；進入update | successor base=authoritative latest；final slot expected value是captured empty或captured valid same-lineage exact ref |
| 任何將發生Draft或equipment mutation的路徑，其**pre-existing** pending projection為nonempty chains | `recovery_pending`；return `0` | command不執行recovery、不retry；login recovery仍唯一owner；尚無command-owned mutation |
| 同一projection為TargetInvalid | `recovery_target_invalid`；return `0` | 同上；不得把invalid target當empty或自行修復 |
| 同一projection為Unavailable | `recovery_unavailable`；return `0` | 同上；不得猜pending為empty |
| First acquisition：deterministic Store identity absent、Draft absent | materialize target with empty base；submit | normal new revision exactly `0`→latest→final equip |
| First acquisition：same-ID Draft完整等於target且base empty | explicit retry | reuse Draft；不mint第二個Draft |
| First acquisition：same-ID Draft不同或帶不合法base | `draft_conflict`；return `0` | preserve Draft；no Store/equip |
| A→B：latest owner-valid、supported、target不同；Draft absent | materialize B，base=authoritative latest；submit successor | same SkillId；oldA immutable |
| A→B：Draft已等於target且base=current latest | explicit retry | reuse and submit |
| A→B：Draft body完整等於current committed latest A，且符合下述closed clean metadata/base形式 | safe command-owned replacement | replace Draft with B/base=current latest，再submit；包括成功submission遺留Draft |
| A→B：Draft既不等於target/current-base，也不符合完整latest-body + closed clean metadata/base | `draft_has_unsubmitted_changes`；return `0` | 不overwrite、delete、auto-rebase；body碰巧等於latest但base不在closed set仍拒絕 |
| B→A rollback | target不同於latest B | 建立新monotonic successor C with A content；不得把latest pointer倒退到oldA |
| Draft route count已32但同ID route存在 | replacement不增加route count，仍可依上列safe rule | 其他encoded capacity仍適用 |
| Draft route count已32且需新route | `draft_limit_reached`；return `0` | zero mutation |
| New identity在formal submission的唯一current `SkillSubmissionPolicySnapshot`被policy quota拒絕 | `draft_retained_quota_rejected`；return `0` | target Draft已合法materialize/reused並保留；no Store/equip；command不得自行preflight quota而改成zero-Draft結果 |
| Existing identity且policy distinct-skill quota後來降低 | 不以New quota阻擋 | 仍受per-skill/global retained revision、encoded capacity及normal validation |
| **需要successor**且latest revision=`Integer.MAX_VALUE` | `revision_exhausted`；return `0` | 在Draft mutation前preflight；no wrap/reuse/commit。already-current/no-successor re-equip不受此row阻擋 |
| command-owned `putDraft`對target Draft回`DRAFT_PERSISTENCE_REJECTED`或`ATTACHMENT_CAPACITY_REJECTED` | `route_capacity_rejected`；return `0` | publication未生效；absent route保持absent，safe-replacement route保留原Draft byte-for-byte；no Store/equip。`DRAFT_LIMIT_REACHED`仍使用上列`draft_limit_reached`；其他invariant-only impossible result依既有fail-fast policy，不fabricate normal result |
| formal submission回`PersistenceCapacityRejected`或Store `CapacityRejected`，包括Attachment transition encoded、document/revision/history/store blob、journal entry/bytes、owner/global histories及retained revisions scopes | `draft_retained_capacity_rejected`；return `0` | target Draft已合法materialize/reused並保留；no partial Store mutation/equip。no-successor re-equip不進formal submission，只受其實際final Attachment transition結果約束 |
| formal submission的validation/CAS/authority/state-change/unavailable或其他`PRE_COMMIT` normal rejection（排除上列quota/capacity） | `draft_retained_submission_rejected`；return `0` | no auto reprepare/retry；old revision/slot unchanged；合法materialized/reused Draft依既有規則保留 |
| formal submission回`SubsystemUnavailableAfterPreparation(POST_COMMIT_STORE_COMMITTED, STORE_JOURNAL_PUBLICATION_INVARIANT)` | `store_committed_journal_publication_invariant`；return `0` | Store aggregate commit已發生，但SavedData Store/journal carrier依既有P4 fail-closed語意成為unavailable且不宣稱journal已publish或結果已durable；不publish Attachment latest、不進final equip、不rollback或自動retry；Draft保留。不得把它改稱`committed_pending_recovery` |
| `Committed` | new immutable exact reference exists and latest publication completed | final slot reread；只准仍等於captured empty或captured valid same-lineage exact value（VALID_CURRENT_NON_TARGET／VALID_OLDER）→new ref |
| Store committed但Attachment latest pending recovery | `committed_pending_recovery`；return `0` | no rollback/equip/clear journal；login recovery owns completion |
| no-successor re-equip的final authoritative slot reread unavailable | `equip_state_unavailable`；return `0` | no Store commit；不猜captured value仍成立、不overwrite slot；latest/Draft不變 |
| no-successor re-equip時final slot變成第三狀態 | `equip_conflict`；return `0` | no Store commit；slot不overwrite；latest/Draft不變 |
| no-successor final set得到typed unavailable/capacity/invariant rejection | `equip_publish_unavailable`；return `0` | no Store commit；slot不overwrite；latest/Draft不變；不得把service rejection冒充第三狀態 |
| no-successor re-equip成功，或`Committed`後final exact reread與set成功 | `equipped_target(CURRENT|LKG)`；return `1` | slot0是captured target exact current ref；前者無Store commit，後者保留new immutable revision/latest |
| Commit成功後final authoritative slot reread unavailable | `committed_not_equipped`；return `0` | new revision/latest remains；不猜slot、不rollback；只有後續persisted-readback/login recovery terminal後才可明確再操作 |
| Commit成功但final slot成為第三狀態或equip失敗 | `committed_not_equipped`；return `0` | new revision/latest remains；slot不overwrite；只有後續persisted-readback/login recovery使pre-existing chain terminal後，later explicit operation才可recover |

Clean replacement的metadata/base形式exact如下：Draft SkillId必須是同一deterministic ID、schema/current structure須可正式decode，body完整等於authoritative current latest；base只能是(a)latest revision 0時的empty、(b)exact current latest，或(c)latest revision >0時同SkillId的exact `latestRevision-1`。foreign SkillId、negative/future revision、其他older base或corrupt metadata均不算clean，即使body碰巧相同也拒絕。這個closed set同時涵蓋first-success retained Draft、successor retained Draft及無變更editor Draft，不把base排除於clean classification之外。

First acquisition在上述條件下的新revision恰為`0`，不是「通常0」。本operation自己的submission可依既有service先寫journal再publish latest；pre-existing gate不重跑，故不自我阻擋同一次final equip。`committed_pending_recovery`，以及正常formal `Committed`路徑之後的`committed_not_equipped`或`equipped_target`，具有本次submission已publish的journal-backed chain；後續starter仍須等persisted-readback/login recovery使該projection成`Available(empty)`。無successor re-equip產生的`equipped_target`沒有本次新journal，不能混入上述集合。`store_committed_journal_publication_invariant`不保證journal已publish，只維持既有P4 unavailable/fail-closed recovery語意；不得承諾login可clear、不得由starter自行修復或自動retry。

所有pre-commit rejection及post-commit non-success terminal都使用bounded translatable product category，不dump另一owner、raw JSON、stack或host path。`return 1`只表示本次明確操作後slot0已經是target exact current ref或已確認它本來如此；`return 0`可能代表(a)zero-mutation rejection、(b)Draft-only retained failure、(c)Store commit且journal/latest pending recovery，(d)Store commit後journal-publication invariant使carrier unavailable，或(e)commit/latest完成但未equip，caller/acceptance必須檢查typed outcome而不能把0等同「沒有mutation」。Template reload本身永不產生此command result。

#### §68.10.3 Fine result → legacy coarse observation

為保持§63.25既有coarse observation consumers，下表完整列出本operation所有正常terminal fine result的唯一向下映射。每個fine result恰好出現在一列；phase-specific名稱防止pre-Draft、Draft-retained與post-commit結果混成同一分類。

| Normal terminal fine result | Legacy coarse observation |
|---|---|
| `source_rejected` | `PROVISION_REJECTED` |
| `template_unavailable`、`STALE_CONTEXT`、`SNAPSHOT_CHANGED` | `PROVISION_AMBIGUOUS_OR_UNAVAILABLE` |
| `attachment_unavailable`、`store_unavailable`、`starter_identity_not_authorized`、`starter_identity_unavailable_or_collision`、`recovery_pending`、`recovery_target_invalid`、`recovery_unavailable`、`equip_state_unavailable`、`equip_publish_unavailable` | `PROVISION_AMBIGUOUS_OR_UNAVAILABLE` |
| `draft_conflict`、`draft_has_unsubmitted_changes`、`draft_limit_reached`、`revision_exhausted`、`route_capacity_rejected` | `PROVISION_DRAFT_ROUTE_REJECTED` |
| `draft_retained_quota_rejected`、`draft_retained_capacity_rejected`、`draft_retained_submission_rejected` | `PROVISION_DRAFT_RECOVERABLE` |
| `store_committed_journal_publication_invariant`、`committed_pending_recovery`、`committed_not_equipped`（包含post-commit final read unavailable、third-state drift或set failure） | `PROVISION_PARTIAL_PERSISTENT_SUCCESS` |
| `slot_occupied`、`slot_unavailable`、`equip_conflict` | `SLOT_OCCUPIED` |
| `already_current(CURRENT|LKG)`、`equipped_target(CURRENT|LKG)` | 無failure coarse observation；return `1` |

`VALID_CURRENT_NON_TARGET`、`VALID_OLDER`、first-acquisition materialization、A→B materialization及`Committed`是表內後續流程的intermediate state，不是normal terminal result。非預期`RuntimeException`／`Error`依§68.9傳播同一throwable object，不fabricate normal fine result或coarse observation。新typed category保留以區分修復路徑；coarse code不得反向推定細分類或mutation數。

### §68.11 `/skill validate template <resource_location>`

唯一首版grammar為：

```text
/skill validate template <resource_location>
```

Permission fixed為level 2：registration使用標準`source.hasPermission(2)`。任何平台授予level 2的server `CommandSourceStack`可執行，包括operator player與server administrative sources；不要求player entity，也不額外按source class發明例外。理由是命令只看系統template、不看player-private content，且所有輸出已bounded；normal-player acquisition仍是permission-0 starter。

結果只直接回覆發出命令的source，使用不broadcast-to-ops的success/failure route；不得因一次validate向其他玩家或全體operator廣播。

Argument經ResourceLocation parser後只查published P10 snapshot；first slice只有`gramarye:starter_bolt_v0`。不得接受host path、URL、inline JSON/code、hidden lower pack、另一玩家Draft或exact player reference。

Command在server logic thread原子捕獲一個immutable service-state tuple：active body/private publication token、`CURRENT|LKG|NONE` origin、以及一份latest installed-attempt status record（fixed classification scalar + bounded diagnostic metadata/summaries）。它再取得current root validation context，復用同一production resolver/migration/analyzer/projector rules重驗**active body**；不得先後分開讀active與rejection status。它不trigger reload或submission。

Primary eligibility與latest attempt是正交兩軸。Primary eligibility由active body當次production重驗的實際結果決定，不由collector是否保留fatal issue決定；collector已飽和後才觀察到fatal時，active仍依該fatal成為non-Ready。只有primary決定return code：

| Active state under current context | Primary header | Return |
|---|---|---:|
| fixed active body valid/submittable，origin CURRENT | `READY_CURRENT` | `1` |
| fixed active body valid/submittable，origin LKG | `READY_LKG` | `1` |
| fixed active body valid且只有bounded warnings | 依origin仍為`READY_CURRENT`或`READY_LKG` | `1` |
| argument不是fixed supported ID | `UNSUPPORTED_TEMPLATE_ID` | `0` |
| no active because missing/initial invalid/fault | `UNAVAILABLE` | `0` |
| active CURRENT或LKG body在current policy/P8 context不再submittable | `STALE_CONTEXT` | `0` |
| policy/profile/validator subsystem unavailable | `INTERNAL_UNAVAILABLE` | `0` |

Latest-attempt field獨立取值為fixed `NONE|ACCEPTED|MISSING_REQUIRED_TEMPLATE|OVERLAPPING_RELOAD|UNKNOWN_TYPE|MIGRATION_FAILED|FUTURE_SCHEMA|DECODE_FAILED|SEMANTIC_INVALID|CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE|STALE_CANDIDATE|INTERNAL_FAILURE`及bounded summaries。其值是§68.6獨立捕獲的fixed classification scalar，即使對應fatal沒有被diagnostic collector保留也不改值；它只描述最近installed resources attempt，不被當成active body verdict，也不改primary return。§68.6已把invalid UTF-8/BOM/trailing/duplicate、所有ingress bound、outer exact-key/identity-field及strict Appearance failures固定映成`DECODE_FAILED`；細因不得另升格成不在此enum的top-level value。例如valid LKG A + unknown B必須是`READY_LKG`, return `1`, `lastAttempt=UNKNOWN_TYPE`；即使B的fatal發生在collector飽和後，B scalar仍是`UNKNOWN_TYPE`而A的eligibility仍只由A當次重驗決定。無A + 同一B才是`UNAVAILABLE`, return `0`, `lastAttempt=UNKNOWN_TYPE`。不得驗B卻把結果標成A，亦不得把B raw payload印出。

Brigadier syntax parse或permission predicate拒絕時handler根本不執行，因此沒有上述產品return或service-state capture；使用平台正常command rejection。Handler執行時，一次輸出最多17個chat components：第一個status header及最多16個issue components；每component的`Component.getString().length()`≤1,024，所有components的該值總和≤17,408；這是Java UTF-16 code-unit coordinate，不是Unicode code point或UTF-8 byte coordinate。16個issue slots先依production deterministic order分配給current revalidation warnings/errors，再把剩餘slots分配給latest-attempt summaries。Fixed classification scalar不是額外issue/component，也不加入retained counts。Header輸出aggregate known `displayOmitted = currentRetainedCount + lastAttemptRetainedCount - totalPrintedIssueComponents`，exact range `0..2,032`；`upstreamTruncated`是current與last-attempt兩個collector flags的OR。Flag為true時不得杜撰任一collector ceiling外的總數。Latest-attempt retained record本身另依§68.7保存`retainedButNotSummarized` scalar，但command不得把它誤當兩axis aggregate。限額在pre-send component construction完成後、送出前按上述值檢查；component separators、wire serialization及client-localized rendering expansion不計入此coordinate。

Side-effect after-set exact為零：不建立／修改Draft、revision、latest、equipped、mana、runtime instance、world或presentation；不reload、不register descriptor、不取得player-private state。直接acceptance驗證相關Draft/Store/Attachment mutation及commit call counts為0、world/runtime/presentation calls為0、service/Store/Attachment owner identities與被查target refs穩定，並驗fatal-after-collector-cap時的exact primary／`lastAttempt`／return、既有output arithmetic與caps；不得把兩個不同時點的whole dynamic Store/Attachment/world dict equality當作通用證據。

### §68.12 Reload、舊revision與active instance

§63.16 P9 reload invalidation完整保留。Resource reload transition關閉P9 admission並boundedly清除active A instance、projectile、continuation、queue及lease；live A不能跨reload存活、不能在B publication後改讀B，也不能用terminal instance作舊語意證明。

同時：

- committed revision A的document bytes、owner、reference、revision number及meaning保持；
- template B publication不改player latest/equipped；
- 玩家再次明確執行starter才可能建立revision B；
- B是same SkillId的new immutable revision，不rewrite A；
- runtime永遠由equipped exact reference取得Store document並在current policy下正式resolve/project，不查template latest；
- 證明A語意時，以Store exact reference及正式resolution/test path重讀A；不復活reload前instance，也不建立public bypass；
- 是否能由既有產品入口重新equip/施放A，依原revision/equipment policy，不因本節假設一個不存在的arbitrary revision command。

### §68.13 Damage end-to-end after-set

只改JSON/validator而未真正到world不是P10完成。批准`{4000,5000}`後，下列責任必須在同一implementation unit窄幅同步：

1. damage descriptor current schema、V0→V1 migration、V1 codec/validator及migration audit；
2. P9 content builder的legacy canonical representation、legacy fingerprint與separate supported-starter predicate；
3. P5 runtime exact starter/action/hit support matchers及exact revision projection；
4. P6 runtime adapter的typed damage mapping、`DamageEffectResolver`與其transaction/plan tests；
5. `P9WorldEffectHandoff` magnitude conversion與one-call commit；
6. exact static/API/JAR/source readers及受影響unit/GameTests。

`P9DamageActionType`必須成為四個descriptor owners中唯一新增mandatory public interface override者：override既有public `payloadMigrationPlan()`以供V0→V1，因此§63.22的descriptor override總數由20變21；其餘三個descriptor仍各自使用empty/default plan且override集合不變。這不新增public top-level type、public locator或第二migration owner。Current V1 decode與transient migrated V0精確共用既有package-private `P9DamageActionPayloadV0` carrier；§63.22的四個payload FQCN after-set及package-private payload type count完全不變。若migration implementation需要private step/helper，其名稱與檔案拆分可自由，但不得成為另一payload carrier、descriptor或migration owner。

#### §68.13.1 Named exact direct-consumer synchronization

下表是目前source tree的逐名同步契約；不是family wildcard。未列的existing consumer預設`VALID_UNCHANGED`。若後續實作證明另一existing path直接消費被改 coordinate，必須先把該exact path加入同一implementation的consumer ledger，不能以package/prefix/count-only放寬。

| Exact existing consumer | Required synchronization | Preserved invariant |
|---|---|---|
| `com.yo1no.gramarye.P9DamageActionType`；`com.yo1no.gramarye.P9DamageActionPayloadV0` | descriptor current schema 0→1、唯一public `payloadMigrationPlan()` override、guarded edge、V1 validator；carrier record source/fields/FQCN不變 | 四payload types after-set不變；V0/5000不得decode成合法V1 |
| `com.yo1no.gramarye.P9StarterSkillContent` | hardcoded legacy `canonicalDraft()`/envelope保持V0/4000並由production migration正常resolve；只同步P10 supported predicate、descriptor-aware current projection與full-content normalization。V1/4000 built-in A只存在新fixed JSON resource，不回寫legacy builder | descriptor registration IDs、two-node graph、Appearance、`StarterGameplayFingerprintV0` exact4000及legacy evidence不被廣泛化 |
| `com.yo1no.gramarye.magic.definition.migration.DescriptorMigrationAudit`；`com.yo1no.gramarye.magic.definition.migration.SkillCandidateResolver` | generic owners實際消費damage plan並證明0→1 consecutive/terminal；只有generic code確有必要時才改source | 不新增damage專用migration truth或繞過generic resolver |
| `com.yo1no.gramarye.SkillRuntimeService` | P5 starter/action/hit exact match由legacy-only判定分離為accepted P10 supported predicate，仍pin exact stored revision | scheduling、token、owner、reload cleanup與所有非P9 paths不變 |

### §68.15 P10原七項工作的接受方式

| Original P10 item | Required product result after approval | Minimum direct acceptance |
|---:|---|---|
| 1. built-in example JSON | production JAR含§68.5固定resource，built-in A semantic等同P9 golden但damage schema1 | exact JAR resource/path/content inventory；無test fixture或額外template entry |
| 2. data reload or submission load | data reload只建立immutable snapshot；explicit starter才建立Draft並呼叫existing submission | initial/current/LKG/stale candidate/override/remove/stop/restart tests；listener已建立但prepare未進入時slot仍free；before/after player state zero on reload |
| 3. known envelope | 四個registered descriptors由complete envelopes正式decode/resolution | exact IDs/schema/payload/closed field tests；無raw special-case executor |
| 4. semantic validation | catalog/validate重用production rules；submission仍用該attempt authoritative context | same invalid inputs在各入口一致分類；collector已達retention ceiling後才觀察到fatal時仍取得該exact fatal scalar且不可Ready；policy/P8 context boundary tests |
| 5. unknown proxy | bounded structural unknown retained throughclassification/round-trip proof，永不submittable/executable | unknown type vs malformed/future/semantic exact negative controls；reject後raw retention=0 |
| 6. migration test | 真實damage V0/4000→V1/4000 edge及V0/5000/future/malformed failures | migration audit、same-family structural failure preservation、old Store bytes unchanged |
| 7. `/skill validate` | §68.11 exact command | permission/source/argument/return/output bounds及zero-side-effect tests |

此外P10完整接受須包含：

- template original-stream byte/depth/tree/string及canonical-payload-byte limit/limit+1；invalid UTF-8、BOM、trailing token、duplicate key；listener建立但actual prepare未進入時slot未占用，valid body必須在open前成功acquire，occupied時為`OVERLAPPING_RELOAD`且no-open/non-owner-no-release，owner在open/read/parse正常或throwable terminal皆只release自己一次；
- exact root/node/envelope key preflight、strict Appearance unknown/null/malformed/超界、identity field、wrong type、missing required field及highest-priority invalid override；
- starter first/repeat/update/rollback/Draft conflict、initial/final Attachment unavailable、Store unavailable、slot classification、coarse-observation mapping、pending recovery/quota/revision/capacity、post-commit Store/journal publication invariant及final equip；
- exact-reference old revision isolation、owner privacy、P4 journal/recovery；
- P7 intent-only、P5/P6 actual result、P8 applied/presentation與dedicated/common client isolation；
- §63.16 active-A reload cleanup，P8 startup hard-fail、§68.8.1三個closed normal outcomes、nested enum exact三constant inventory與wrong-thread/server fault、pre-install failure retained-stage、post-install P8/root/P10 fault marker、live P8 exhaustion、player-sync no-P10-publication、Stopping/Stopped/late-reader/cross-epoch single-flight order；stop/restart時old actual body阻止第二reader，unentered old work不阻擋，late result不得stage，release不自動重讀，且無double activation、ghost或B reinterpretation；
- bounded collector已滿後production才觀察fatal的直接negative control：primary仍等於該fatal classification、candidate／active重驗不可Ready；原retained summaries、known `displayOmitted`與`upstreamTruncated`依既有公式，exclusive control marker、`CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE`及unexpected `INTERNAL_FAILURE`優先規則保持。

這些是一份正常接受清單，不新增formal gate數量、attempt lock、evidence seal、專用report validator或多層successor campaign。

### §68.16 Same-JAR A/B product acceptance

同一個frozen mod JAR下以external datapack override完成：

1. Load A（schema1、magnitude4000）；snapshot=`CURRENT`。
2. 執行`/skill validate template gramarye:starter_bolt_v0`，得到`READY_CURRENT/1`；相關Draft/Store/Attachment mutation與world/runtime call counts皆0，authority identities/target refs穩定。
3. 正常玩家P明確執行`/gramarye starter`；經Draft/submission/Store/equip取得revision A。
4. P按原R input，經P7/P5/P6/world造成exact `4.0F` unperturbed health delta與既有attribution/applied fact；logs alone不算結果。
5. 因成功submission留下pending journal，先完成真實playerdata save/logout；以同一UUID玩家P reconnect，讓既有login recovery完成persisted-readback安全清除，並直接觀察`PendingRecoveryProjection.Available(empty)`。不得用starter自行clear，也不得跳過此步開始下一次mutation。
6. 保持Java/classes/JAR不變，只把external JSON的magnitude改為5000並執行supported reload。
7. Reload依§63.16清理任何active A instance；Store revision A、owner、exact reference及bytes保持，latest/equip沒有因reload自動改變。
8. B candidate valid時publish `CURRENT`。同一UUID玩家P再次明確執行同一starter；用同一SkillId及base=A正式提交successor B並equip exact B。
9. P再次走原R/P7/P5/P6/world path，造成exact `5.0F`；不新增packet、world旁路或raw sender。
10. 以正式Store exact-reference resolution重讀A，證明A仍為4.0 semantics；不復活reload前terminal instance。
11. 再次完成真實playerdata save/logout及同一UUID reconnect/login recovery，直接觀察B submission的pending projection成`Available(empty)`；未terminal前不得開始rollback mutation。
12. 把JSON由B改回A並reload後，再次明確操作建立new successor C=A，不把latest倒退到舊revision A。
13. Appearance可另做合法A/B，證明完整content equality與P8 pinned-revision presentation，但不能替代上述4.0/5.0 gameplay proof。
14. Invalid B negative controls分別證明UNKNOWN、V0/5000 migration failure、V1 malformed、future schema、semantic invalid。若已有A，active明示`LKG A`且rejected B只作diagnostic；validate primary仍依A current-context結果決定；若無A則UNAVAILABLE。

### §68.17 Direct regression與禁止事項

Future implementation至少同步真正受影響的direct consumers；不得為維持舊expected而放寬wildcard、刪除negative test或增加另一truth。下列family是實際影響面，不固定private檔案拆分：

- template codec/loader/snapshot/lifecycle與one built-in resource；
- descriptor migration/resolver/analyzer/projector及read-only validation adapter；
- starter content/identity/command/submission/Store/Attachment direct tests；
- P5 runtime matcher、P6 adapter/resolver、world handoff、damage/transaction/applied-fact tests；
- P8 availability/presentation、reload lifecycle、dedicated/JAR/resource/static gates；
- P7 intent/owner/exact-reference regressions保持。

既有loader／validation direct tests須直接覆蓋兩個本節定稿邊界：(1) listener-created-but-unentered零slot、actual owner normal／throwable exactly-once release、failed acquire不釋放他人及stop/restart late-stage rejection；(2) collector retention已滿後production才觀察fatal仍固定正確primary／`lastAttempt`並保持既有diagnostic arithmetic。不得為這些案例另建report verifier、phase、framework或第二套semantic validator。

本節明確禁止：

1. arbitrary file/URL/inline JSON import、directory-wide template catalog或第二player acquisition command；
2. reload自動submission、auto-equip、background player update、ACK、persistent template ledger或script DSL；
3. second Store、second descriptor registry、second migration truth、template-specific permissive validator或parallel runtime dispatch；
4. reflection/global locator/public service getter、raw-event sender、client gameplay authority；
5. 用template ID、raw bytes或gameplay-only fingerprint取代完整content equality；
6. 把unknown變成no-op、把malformed/future/semantic invalid都叫Unknown、或宣稱JSON whitespace/key order逐byte保留；
7. LKG保留old ResourceManager/profile/policy context、永久免驗、暗用lower pack或顯示rejected B active；
8. rewrite old revision、latest rollback、revision wrap/reuse、silent Draft overwrite、slot takeover或automatic retry；
9. 以trace/log/test expected變化替代實際world health或P8 consumer result；
10. 由P10提前宣稱P11長期multiplayer/replay closure。
11. 為reader ownership新增queue、scheduler、lease registry、timeout reclamation、cancel monitor或auto-reread；不得把Future已completed／cancelled當成actual body已退出的證據，也不得新增public／internal bridge繞過本節marker與slot責任。

### §68.18 批准內容的 authority落地與 implementation先後

使用者已整體批准本節；本次P10-A1 repository adoption只修改以下兩個repository paths：

```text
docs/architecture/P5-A-server-runtime-event-kernel.md
src/test/java/com/yo1no/gramarye/P8S2BoundaryTest.java
```

Architecture只作strict EOF append：原H5 prefix bytes完全保持；H6 whole length/hash完成後實算，不把hash寫進被hash正文。Identity test保留既有test class/method ID、原prefix assertions及所有unrelated P7/P8 assertions，只新增H5 prefix與更新H6 whole-file identity；不得用runtime file自算expected。除這兩paths外authority-adoption source delta為0。該authority closure完成後，P10 implementation才可依下列依賴先後進行：

1. damage V1/migration及direct descriptor consumers；
2. identity-free codec、fixed resource、bounds及pure classification；
3. root-owned stage/publish/LKG與P8→P10→P5 lifecycle；
4. read-only validate command；
5. template-backed create-or-update starter及formal submission/equipment；
6. end-to-end damage/P5/P6/world/P8 synchronization與same-JAR A/B；
7. affected compile/unit/GameTest/dedicated/JAR/CI acceptance按現行AGENTS普通流程執行。

這個順序不建立新的產品phase名稱，不授權本次authority adoption回合先寫production code，也不恢復exact-once、single-commit/push或專用formal campaign制度。

### §68.19 Definition of Done與phase state

P10只有在一個明確candidate上同時滿足下列產品結果時才可稱complete：

1. §68.5固定built-in resource與所有§68.7 bounds已實作且有直接邊界證據，包括listener未進入時零slot、actual prepare entry取得slot及owner正常／異常terminal exactly-once release；
2. known/unknown/malformed/future/migration/semantic分類、真實V0→V1 migration與zero raw leak成立；primary由第一個實際fatal production result決定且不受diagnostic retention影響，collector已滿後的fatal直接negative control成立；
3. actual-prepare-entry cross-epoch single-flight、snapshot/LKG/current-context、P8 startup hard-fail、pre-install/post-install P8/root/P10 failure與truthful marker、live P8 exhaustion、player-sync no-publication、Stopping/Stopped/late-reader/restart及唯一root pessimistic-transition→P8→P10→P5 full-sync order成立；unentered old work不占slot、actual old owner未terminal前不容許第二reader、late result不得stage且release不自動重讀；
4. validate command的permission/return/output/zero-side-effect成立；active eligibility與`lastAttempt`兩軸、fatal-after-cap exact scalar及既有summary／omitted／truncated算術均有直接證據；
5. 同一UUID正常玩家由A經persisted-readback/login recovery terminal，再經明確操作取得B successor；Draft/Store/owner/recovery/slot與post-commit結果規則全成立；
6. same-JAR A/B真正造成4.0F/5.0F product結果，old A exact revision仍保持語意，active A在reload依§63.16清理；
7. 所有受影響regressions、dedicated classloading、JAR/resource inventory與required CI成功。

### §69.1 正文、來源與效力層級

本次使用者確認L1／R1／F1／C1–C6及ARM／NO_RELEASE／zero／captured-bound冷卻规则；新玩家技能內容、學習或equip新入口、技能切換／selection產品明確OUTSIDE_THIS_STAGE。舊D1/D2人工hit delay、claimed-only/nonplayer-only/null-causer、starter強制200-tick冷卻仍拒絕。C4a必要非斷線轉換控制不是被排除的技能切換UI。

## §70 DP-2 Scope D — 定義、資料與 compiler 採用登錄

正式正文為 [20_DP2_ScopeD_SpellDefinition與可選SkillManifest修正案.md](../codex-spec/20_DP2_ScopeD_SpellDefinition與可選SkillManifest修正案.md)（Scope D 1.0，2026-11-11）。D-01R2、D-02～D-09 與 M-DUP 只在正文列明的 definition／data／compiler contract 範圍生效。D-01R2 以 owner-private `SpellDefinition` 為獨立核心，`SkillManifest` 為可選高階定義。一般作者引用只保存 Spell 身分；未來接受新 root 時才由一致的 owner catalog 固定完整 exact closure，已接受工作、program、instance 及 child 沿用該 closure。M-DUP 限同一 Manifest revision，每個 Spell identity 最多一個 entry；Draft 可保重複材料並具名診斷，正式發布拒絕重複，禁止靜默去重。

§69 的保留與替換仍依原範圍。C4a 的獨立非斷線轉換控制、configuration／parking／handoff 與正常首次 TRY 契約保持；D3 的認證連線 exact capture、server generation 與舊工作的隔離保持；C6 的原配置 owner、分層 bounds／backpressure、已受理責任與保存負載契約保持。P11 維持 `COMPLETE—PASS / PRESERVED`。原 P5／P6 runtime authority 與 §47.3／§47.4 production vocabulary 保持，17／18／19 未明列替換之條款維持。

本輪為文件限定採用。M1 data foundation、resolver／compiler implementation 與 runtime 尚未開始；Scope V／E／UI／P12 未授。Canonical 發布效力依適用的直接檢查、candidate required checks、fast-forward 整合及 main CI 結果確認；檢查與實際發布身分留於本輪採用紀錄。
